items.description: Help Us Build The Future of Travel At Airalo , we're making it easier for people to stay connected wherever they travel. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world. Today, we're a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy. We're fully remote by design, genuinely global, and united by a shared mission to make travel simpler for everyone. Your Next Destination Location: Remote. Contract: Full-time, permanent. Benefits: Learn more about our benefits here in this link - https://airalo-public.notion.site/Benefits-25396a97ffca81fb9bc1f0be479f1be3?pvs=74 Languages: English is our main working language day to day, so you'll need to be comfortable communicating in it both in meetings and async. Airalo's fully remote Data team is growing, and so is our ambition for how we measure marketing. You'll help Airalo decide where to invest the next dollar by owning how we measure marketing performance: attribution, the data models behind it, and incrementality testing that shows what really works, turning evidence into investment decisions across the globe. You'll pair solid measurement expertise, including causal inference, with strong core analytics. You'll guide teams on what to measure and test, defend our framework with senior stakeholders, and make sure data changes decisions. This is a small, growing team and a capability that is new to the business: you'll build the process, not inherit it. Expect your time to be split between measurement work (attribution, data modelling and incrementality) and the day-to-day analytics Growth and Marketing rely on. What You'll Do Support our marketing attribution models and methodology: review how conversions are credited across channels, reconcile platform-reported and first-party numbers, and keep the approach trusted and documented. Design and maintain the marketing data models behind measurement (spend, attribution, orders and customer cohorts) with Analytics Engineering, with clear definitions, tests and documentation. Support Growth and Marketing with ad-hoc and core analytics, such as campaign and market performance, self-serve dashboards and AI-assisted analytics. Design and run geo experiments from simulation-based power analysis and market selection to success criteria and read-out, working with the marketing performance team. Co-own a prioritised quarterly incrementality test roadmap across channels and markets, ranked by decision value, cost, feasibility (including properly powered tests) and learning, and track each test through to a decision. Handle spillover, seasonality and small-market noise, and report incremental CAC and incremental ROAS with honest uncertainty. Turn test results into investment guidance: estimate marginal returns and saturation by channel and market, and recommend where the next dollar should go and where to pull back. Help set and document our causal measurement standards: which method when, what counts as sufficient evidence, and how results calibrate attribution and MMM for budget allocation. Defend the framework under challenge from channel owners and leaders, and pressure-test platform claims. Guide Growth, Acquisition and Finance from business question to testable hypothesis to budget decision, and build literacy on attributed versus incremental performance. Build reusable experiment tooling and templates, work with Analytics Engineering and MarTech on the data experiments needed, and document every test and decision as you build this capability from scratch. What You'll Bring 3+ years of experience in marketing measurement (attribution, incrementality or marketing mix modelling), with a track record of analysis that changed real budget decisions. Solid grounding in causal inference and experimental design: randomised and quasi-experimental methods such as synthetic control and difference-in-differences, simulation-based power analysis to size and design tests, and knowing when each approach breaks. Strong statistical judgement: you can quantify uncertainty, explain it simply, and resist overclaiming. Hands-on experience with marketing attribution models and their limits, including reconciling platform-reported results with first-party data. Familiarity with how experiments calibrate MMM and attribution, and with marginal-return and budget-optimisation thinking (saturation, diminishing returns). Expert SQL and Python, production-quality code, a modern warehouse (BigQuery or Snowflake) and a BI tool such as Lightdash or Looker. Strong data modelling skills: designing clean, tested and documented models (dbt or similar) for marketing spend, attribution and customer data, and working closely with Analytics Engineering. Strong core analytics skills: marketing and customer metrics (CAC, LTV, retention, funnel and cohort analysis), dashboards and self-serve BI, and the judgement to prioritise ad-hoc requests alongside the test roadmap. Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders: you hold a position under challenge, have shaped a roadmap, and say no with a clear rationale. Comfortable with ambiguity and with data that is still improving: you're a proactive self-starter who is happy to create a new process or capability in a small, fast-growing team. Compensation At Airalo, we believe in roaming-free recruitment. Just as we provide clear connectivity for travelers, we provide clear salary ranges for our candidates. 🌍 This role is remote and open to candidates across our supported locations in Europe. The range below reflects the full salary range for this role across the countries where it’s available: 📍UK: £64,000 - £96,000 📍Spain: €62,000- €93,000 📍Germany: €68,000- €102,000 Your Home Destination: Local market rates and cost of living vary, so your specific range depends on where you’re based. Most people join in the first half of the band, which leaves you plenty of room to grow, and you’ll see exactly how that looks from day one. In exceptional cases, where a candidate’s skills and experience clearly exceed what the role requires, we’re happy to talk about going higher. We’ll walk through your range together on your first call with our Talent team, so we’re all aligned for takeoff! Additional Information If you are interested in this position, please apply via the link. Why People Join Us We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product were customers first. Our team spans 60+ countries, united by a shared belief that great work happens when people are trusted to own what they do. There's trust to own what you do, space to focus without constant layers of process, and a clear sense of what you're responsible for from day one. As Airalo continues to grow, so do the opportunities to learn, take on new challenges, and make a real impact - from anywhere in the world. Before You Hit Apply By applying, you acknowledge and agree that, in case of successful application, Airalo may request to run background checks as a condition for entering into an agreement with you. Rest assured that these checks will only occur upon your prior consent and at the end of the selection process, and will be strictly limited to what is allowed under the laws that are applicable to you. All data that you share or that we collect in connection with such checks will be processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy, available here: www.airalo.com/more-info/privacy-policy?srsltid=AfmBOooBT0rXAj1FaNelZ3VfN0wvhwzvAoxdtHnOKSVETpiSjiXVuycy We sincerely thank all applicants in advance for submitting their interest in this opportunity. Airalo is an equal-opportunity employer and values diversity, equity & inclusion. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations upon request for individuals with disabilities throughout our job interview process.

items.description: As a Data Engineer at Meta, you will shape the future of people-facing and business-facing products we build across our entire family of applications (Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, Reality Labs, Threads). Your technical skills and analytical mindset will be utilized designing and building some of the world's most extensive data sets, helping to craft experiences for billions of people and hundreds of millions of businesses worldwide.In this role, you will collaborate with software engineering, data science, and product management teams to design/build scalable data solutions across Meta to optimize growth, strategy, and user experience for our 3 billion plus users, as well as our internal employee community.You will be at the forefront of identifying and solving some of the most interesting data challenges at a scale few companies can match. By joining Meta, you will become part of a world-class data engineering community dedicated to skill development and career growth in data engineering and beyond.Data Engineering: You will guide teams by building optimal data artifacts (including datasets and visualizations) to address key questions. You will refine our systems, design logging solutions, and create scalable data models. Ensuring data security and quality, and with a strong focus on efficiency, you will suggest architecture and development approaches and data management standards to address complex analytical problems.Product leadership: You will use data to shape product development, identify new opportunities, and tackle upcoming challenges. You'll ensure our products add value for users and businesses, by prioritizing projects, and driving innovative solutions to respond to challenges or opportunities.Communication and influence: You won't simply present data, but tell data-driven stories. You will convince and influence your partners using clear insights and recommendations. You will build credibility through structure and clarity, and be a trusted strategic partner.ResponsibilitiesConceptualize and own the data architecture for multiple large-scale projects, while evaluating design and operational cost-benefit tradeoffs within systems* Create and contribute to frameworks that improve the efficacy of logging data, while working with data infrastructure to triage issues and resolve* Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and data scientists to understand data needs, representing key data insights visually in a meaningful way* Define and manage Service Level Agreements for all data sets in allocated areas of ownership* Determine and implement the security model based on privacy requirements, confirm safeguards are followed, address data quality issues, and evolve governance processes within allocated areas of ownership* Design, build, and launch collections of sophisticated data models and visualizations that support multiple use cases across different products or domains* Solve our most challenging data integration problems, utilizing optimal Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) patterns, frameworks, query techniques, sourcing from structured and unstructured data sources* Assist in owning existing processes running in production, optimizing complex code through advanced algorithmic concepts* Optimize pipelines, dashboards, frameworks, and systems to facilitate easier development of data artifacts* Influence product and cross-functional teams to identify data opportunities to drive impact* Mentor team members by giving/receiving actionable feedbackQualificationsBachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience* 7+ years of experience where the primary responsibility involves working with data. This could include roles such as data analyst, data scientist, data engineer, or similar positions* 7+ years of experience with SQL, ETL, data modeling, and at least one programming language (e.g., Python, C++, C#, Scala or others.) Master's or Ph.D degree in a STEM field* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies

That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and,…
items.description: What do we do? Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better. We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally. The role: We are looking for a Head of Data Science to build Paddle's data science capability from the ground up. Our Merchant of Record model gives us a data position no PSP or billing provider has: subscription and pricing context alongside granular payment-outcome data, across thousands of software businesses. This role exists to turn that into economic value by putting machine learning and agentic systems into production. The mandate is deliberately narrow and deliberately ambitious: data science at Paddle owns automated decisioning inside the product — traditional machine learning and agentic systems alike — not decision-support analytics. We have a long list of candidate opportunities than we can fund, spanning payment performance and revenue recovery, sales and marketing operations, growth and monetisation intelligence, and risk, trust and compliance. We have a working hypothesis about which of these pays back first, and we'll share it — but part of the job in your first quarter is to pressure-test it, size the alternatives yourself, and tell us where to start. This is a founding role, and for the first few quarters it is a building role more than a managing one. You'll be the only person in the function: doing the analysis, engineering the features, training and evaluating the models or agents, taking the first system live with our engineering teams — and then operating it, answerable for its uptime, its drift and its numbers. Once the first use cases are proving out, you'll hire and lead a hub-and-spoke team of data scientists and machine learning engineers embedded across our highest-value business areas. You'll report into the VP of Data and work in close partnership with Product, Payments, Engineering, Risk and Finance. What you'll do: Prioritise which opportunities have the biggest impact.. Build a value-based use-case backlog across payment performance and revenue recovery, sales and marketing operations, growth and monetisation intelligence, and risk, trust and compliance; size the leading candidates properly; and make the call on sequencing with the relevant Product, Risk, RevOps and Finance stakeholders. This gets refreshed quarterly. Personally deliver the first system end to end: the analysis and back-test, the features, the model, policy or agent, the deployment, and the shadow and A/B tests that prove it works. Not a spec handed to someone else to build. Operate what you deploy. Own monitoring, retraining, drift response, incident handling and rollback for live decisioning, alongside the engineering teams whose services call it — and set the expectation that the function runs its systems rather than shipping them. Work across both traditional ML and agentic systems, and be honest about which a problem actually needs: a propensity or uplift model, a policy of rules, or an agent with tools, evals against golden answer sets and trace-level observability. Several of our strongest candidate use cases point each way. Build and lead the team — hire senior data scientists embedded in value areas and machine learning engineers in the hub, and set the professional standards, shared methods and reusable components the function runs on. Establish the production stack alongside Data Platform and Engineering: reproducible training data, code and artefacts; a model registry; inference services with real latency, availability and rollback requirements; historically accurate features where decisions need backdated reconstruction; eval harnesses and trace observability for agentic workflows; and monitoring for data quality, drift, model performance and economic outcomes. Start ad hoc where that's sufficient and platformise once the first use cases have shown what's actually needed. Own value capture end to end. Shadow-test and A/B test every deployment against the incumbent strategy, translate metric movement into a financial number on a methodology co-signed by Finance, and publish a quarterly report on realised value. Set the governance model for automated decisioning — proportionate risk assessment, clear ownership, latency and availability requirements, human escalation and rollback — working with Legal, Privacy, Compliance and Risk on GDPR, EU AI Act and payments obligations, and producing the evidence early enough to shape the design. Define the boundaries and the working relationship with Product Science, Analytics Engineering, Data Platform and AI Enablement, so accountability for decision support versus automated decisioning stays unambiguous. Deliver cross-functionally: embed in delivery groups with product owners, domain experts and platform engineers rather than handing models over the wall. We'd love to hear from you if you: Experienced leading data science or ML teams that own systems in production, with deployments that moved a commercial metric and kept running afterwards. Proofs of concept and dashboards are not what we're hiring for. Hands-on now, not formerly. Your first quarters are spent writing SQL and Python, engineering features, evaluating models and agents, and doing the work that gets a system live — not reviewing someone else's. Experienced across both traditional ML and agentic systems, and clear about how they differ in practice: propensity and uplift models, feature pipelines and drift on one side; tool and context design, prompt and retrieval iteration, evals against golden answer sets and trace observability on the other. Practised at running live systems rather than just launching them — monitoring, retraining, incident response, rollback, and the on-call reality of a decision the business depends on. Pragmatic about method: happy to argue for rules or heuristics where they capture most of the value, and to reserve models and agents for where they genuinely earn their keep. Comfortable with an undefined starting point. There's a long list of candidate use cases and a strong internal hypothesis, but no fixed roadmap — you'll be expected to form your own view, back it with numbers, and defend it to an executive audience. Strong on measurement — experimentation, uplift modelling, back-testing — and willing to hold your own work to a financial number that Finance will scrutinise. Fluent in the engineering side of production ML and agents (training pipelines, model registries, inference services, feature stores, drift detection, trace observability) and able to hold your own with senior engineers on latency, availability, observability and rollback. Able to hire, level and develop senior data scientists and ML engineers, and to set standards for a function that doesn't exist yet. Credible with executives and commercial stakeholders: you can take a use case from business problem to value estimate to prioritisation decision, and say no to low-value work. Experienced in payments, fintech, subscriptions, high-volume commercial operations or another regulated transactional domain — enough to get to a credible value estimate in a new area quickly. Comfortable treating regulated ML as a design constraint rather than paperwork — model risk assessment, DPIAs, auditability, traceability of model and policy versions to production decision logic. Everyone is welcome at Paddle At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer, we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We’re more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you’ll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group. Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together. Why you’ll love working at Paddle We’re a diverse, growing group of Paddlers who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture. We live and breathe our values, which are: Paddle Together - “None of us, is as smart as all of us” Paddle Simply - “Simple can be harder than complex: you have to get your thinking clean to make it simple” Paddle for others - “We can realise our wildest dreams, so long as we help enough other people to realise theirs” We offer a full suite of benefits, including attractive salaries, stock options, unlimited holidays, enhanced parental leave, retirement plans, private healthcare and well-being initiatives. We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training. Connecting at Paddle We’re a ‘digital-first’ company , which means our Paddlers always have the freedom to choose where, when and how they work within our hub locations. We recognize that where our Paddlers do their best work is unique to them and we provide trust and autonomy for everyone to work in a way which fits them best. We also value the power of connection and have invested in global hubs which help local communities flourish and bring us together for focused collaboration. Our Paddle hubs: In Europe: UK (London headquarters), Portugal (Lisbon hub), Netherlands and Ireland (Dublin hub) In North America: Austin, TX (USA) and Toronto (Canada) Our hub philosophy creates an engaging experience for all Paddlers, wherever, whenever and however we choose to work. To support this, we focus hiring within our hubs and will always openly share the available locations for each open position on our job description.

items.description: About Pleo Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together. About the role Pleo's Intelligence function covers the full analytical picture - product behaviour, GTM performance, commercial data science, financial reporting, and operational intelligence. The Analytics Engineers who serve these teams own the data modelling layer that all of it runs on: dbt models, metric definitions, and semantic layer contributions that analysts, product teams, and AI tools depend on to get consistent, trustworthy answers. You'll be embedded in the Product Intelligence team, building the tracking, experimentation, and data modelling foundations that make product data trustworthy and self-serve. You'll join a close-knit team actively migrating our analytics stack onto a new Analytics Warehouse and Omni, moving off legacy tools like Looker and Hippocampus. If you want to build the infrastructure that other people's product decisions run on rather than just report on what exists, this is the opportunity for you. Who you'll work with and reporting to You will report to an Analytics Manager leading Product Intelligence and Growth Intelligence. You'll partner closely with Product Managers, Product Analysts, and Engineering to get tracking, experimentation, and metric definitions right from the ground up. You'll also engage with the broader Analytics Engineering community across Pleo to drive shared standards, especially around the semantic layer that keeps metrics consistent across the organization. What you'll be doing Build and maintain dbt models in our new Analytics Warehouse, using a clean, layered architecture and migrating logic off legacy tools as you go. Own tracking plan implementation and QA directly in Segment and Amplitude in close partnership with Product and Engineering. Support experimentation by modelling assignment and outcome data into structured formats that analysts and PMs can query directly. Define and document metrics in our semantic layer, ensuring a single authoritative definition so downstream BI tools and AI applications yield consistent answers. Apply AI-augmented data modelling practices as a standard part of how you write, review, and migrate code. Partner with Product Managers and Analysts to turn one-off questions into durable, reusable data models. Maintain data quality in your domain through dbt tests, freshness SLAs, and proactive monitoring. What you bring Solid SQL and dbt experience, with a clear comfort owning models end to end. Working knowledge of event-based tracking tools like Segment or Amplitude. Experience with Git-based development workflows, including opening and reviewing pull requests. Clear communication skills to explain data definitions and structures to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Genuine day-to-day use of AI tooling as part of your standard coding and workflow routine. Comfort navigating ambiguity and untangling legacy logic to build modern foundations. This role is NOT a good fit if You only want to write dashboards without touching or owning the underlying data models. You require rigid processes and heavy upfront structure before taking initiative. You prefer to avoid data migration, cleanup work, and legacy system refactoring. Your first 6 months Ramp up: Master our dbt project structure, tracking plans, and migration roadmap while shipping small, reviewed code changes early on. Take ownership: Own a dedicated slice of the migration, such as an event domain or our core experimentation data models. Drive consistency: Establish semantic layer definitions for your domain so analysts and PMs can self-serve accurate metrics without custom workarounds. Our tech stack context Data warehouse: GCP / BigQuery (new Analytics Warehouse) Transformation: dbt Orchestration: Airflow Tracking and Oroduct Analytics: Segment, Amplitude BI and Analytics: Omni (migrating off legacy Looker and Hippocampus) Languages: SQL Show me the benefits! Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!) Lunch is on us for your work days—enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office. Comprehensive private healthcare depending on your location (coverage options include Vitality, Alan, or Médis). 25 days of annual holiday plus public holidays, with the option to purchase 5 additional days through salary sacrifice. Flexible working options supporting both hybrid and fully remote setups. Free mental health and well-being support through MyndUp. Generous paid parental leave policies to support growing families. The interview process Intro Call: 30 minutes with our Talent Partner SQL Test: Completed via CoderPad Hiring Manager Interview: 45 minutes with our Data & Analytics Manager Team Interview & Live Case: Data modelling case via CodeSignal Final Interview: 30 minutes with our VP of Data & AI Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success! Last time we hired an Analytics Engineer, we received a total of 173 applications but only 10 were selected for an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include: CV writing and content: it was very clear that many of the CVs we saw were very generic and AI generated. There is no issue with leveraging AI to help with CV writing, there was little indication of what real impact the candidates had in their previous experience. You might have heard of the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit Laszlo Bock ~2014), this is a great way to give a clear picture of what you have actually worked on. Some link or quick description of the companies you’ve worked with is also a great help. Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process. Profile to role fit: there was misunderstanding about the type of experience we expect from an Analytics Engineer and we received many applications from candidates who had never been exposed to a product-led environment or had been exclusively focused on SQL/dbt work when we’re looking for both technical and stakeholders management and team collaboration experience. To be perfectly clear, this is NOT a Data Engineer role or a Data Analyst role! This is a heavily-driven dbt modelling role, experience in this area is critical. We’ve taken great care in writing this role description to reflect the reality of the job as best as possible, please ensure you read it carefully and highlight on your CV the experience relevant to what we are looking for. About your application English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us. A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails. Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us. Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you. Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here . Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role. Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote - MX Who We Are Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually. The Opportunity We’re looking for a Senior DataOps Engineer to help operate, scale, and improve the data platforms that support Oportun’s analytics, engineering, and business teams. This role will focus on Databricks, AWS, data pipelines, databases, observability, automation, and production support. You’ll be responsible for keeping critical data-platform services reliable, secure, performant, and cost-effective while partnering closely with Data Engineering, Analytics, Security, Cloud Infrastructure, Database, and application teams. Success in this role means improving platform reliability, reducing operational friction, strengthening automation, and helping teams resolve issues quickly and sustainably. At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in. What You'll Do Your day-to-day You’ll administer and support Databricks workspaces, cluster policies, compute configurations, jobs, workflows, libraries, service principals, permissions, and platform integrations. You’ll support Unity Catalog, including access governance, catalog and schema permissions, and secure data sharing. You’ll monitor and troubleshoot Delta Live Tables, Spark jobs, Delta Lake workloads, and data pipelines, including failures, performance issues, recovery, and data-quality concerns. You’ll maintain secure and reliable integrations between Databricks and AWS services, including S3, IAM, networking, VPC connectivity, and external data sources. You’ll support AWS infrastructure used by the data platform, including EC2, VPC, IAM, security groups, networking, patching, and operational access. You’ll support MariaDB/MySQL and MongoDB environments, including availability, monitoring, connectivity, backup coordination, performance troubleshooting, and recovery. You’ll build and maintain monitoring, dashboards, logs, metrics, and alerts across Databricks, pipelines, databases, infrastructure, and integrations. You’ll participate in on-call support and lead investigation, mitigation, recovery, communication, and root-cause analysis for production incidents. You’ll build and maintain infrastructure and automation using Terraform, Terraform Enterprise, Git, GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines, and scripting. You’ll automate repeatable operational activities such as provisioning, access configuration, monitoring deployment, recovery, and platform changes. You’ll manage secure access controls, secrets, certificates, TLS configuration, service accounts, and IAM roles across platform services. You’ll improve operational readiness through runbooks, recovery procedures, architecture diagrams, standards, escalation paths, and technical documentation. You’ll partner with engineering and infrastructure teams to improve capacity planning, platform performance, cost visibility, and resource optimization. You’ll look for practical ways to use AI and automation to improve troubleshooting, documentation, incident response, and operational efficiency. Who You Are The right fit looks like this You’re a hands-on platform engineer who enjoys solving complex production problems and improving the systems behind critical data workloads. You think beyond the immediate issue, look for root causes, and build solutions that make the platform more reliable and easier to operate. You’re comfortable working across cloud infrastructure, data platforms, databases, automation, and security. You communicate clearly during incidents, take ownership through resolution, and consistently look for ways to reduce repetitive work and improve operational maturity. What You Bring Skills & experience Required Strong experience supporting production data platforms, cloud infrastructure, or DataOps environments. Hands-on experience administering and supporting Databricks, including workspaces, jobs, workflows, compute, cluster policies, and access controls. Experience supporting Spark, Delta Lake, and Delta Live Tables workloads. Strong experience with AWS services such as EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, security groups, CloudWatch, and networking. Experience with infrastructure as code using Terraform and Terraform Enterprise or similar tools. Experience supporting MariaDB/MySQL and MongoDB in production environments. Strong understanding of monitoring, observability, alerting, and incident-management practices. Experience with CI/CD, Git, GitHub Actions, and automation using Bash, Python, PowerShell, or similar scripting languages. Experience troubleshooting platform performance, connectivity, permissions, certificates, TLS, and integration issues. Experience with production support, root-cause analysis, post-incident reviews, and on-call operations. Strong understanding of security and access concepts such as IAM, RBAC, secrets management, certificates, and secure connectivity. Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work across Data Engineering, Analytics, Security, Infrastructure, Database, and application teams. Nice to Have Experience with Unity Catalog, Databricks SQL, Databricks CLI, REST APIs, and Databricks asset or deployment bundles. Experience with Kubernetes administration and production troubleshooting. Experience with monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or similar platforms. Experience with Rootly or similar incident-management platforms. Experience with MongoDB Atlas, Ops Manager, or comparable MongoDB tooling. Experience with MariaDB/MySQL replication, schema migrations, indexing, backup validation, and restore procedures. Experience with capacity planning, cloud cost optimization, and workload performance tuning. Experience implementing or improving data governance, compliance controls, or audit processes. Experience using AI-assisted tools to improve operations, troubleshooting, documentation, or automation. Our AI Mindset We build with AI. We lead with judgment. AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work. We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting , willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle. In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together. Why Oportun What's in it for you Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment. Some of the benefits available to eligible employees include: Mexico Benefits: Medical Insurance Savings Fund Life Insurance Internet and Electricity Allowance Paid time off such as vacation and parental leave Eligibility and plan details vary by location and employment status. To learn more about Oportun and our benefits, visit oportun.com/careers #LI-REMOTE #LI-GK1 We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment opportunities without regard to race, age, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other category protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. California applicants can find a copy of Oportun's CCPA Notice here: https://oportun.com/privacy/california-privacy-notice/ . We will never request personal identifiable information (bank, credit card, etc.) before you are hired. We do not charge you for pre-employment fees such as background checks, training, or equipment. If you think you have been a victim of fraud by someone posing as us, please report your experience to the FBI’s Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3). To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/oportun-sr-dataops-engineer-r14334

items.description: About the Role We're looking for an Operations Specialist to help transform how we scale and deliver talent for high-growth AI projects. You'll join our team within Expert Operations (XOps), working to simplify complex workflows, eliminate repetitive tasks, and build AI-powered automations that help us meet contributor demand efficiently and at scale. This is a hands-on role with a high degree of ownership, ideal for someone who enjoys solving operational challenges, experimenting with AI tools, and turning manual processes into smarter, more scalable systems. Location & Work Authorization Requirements This is a remote position open exclusively to candidates currently based in Argentina, Brazil, or Mexico. Applicants must reside in one of these three countries and have valid legal authorization to work in their country of residence. Both requirements are mandatory to be considered for this role. Your Impact Map and analyse end-to-end fulfillment workflows, from project headcount requests through contributor activation, to identify opportunities for automation and process improvement. Design, build, and maintain AI agents, automated workflows, and internal tools that streamline recruiting and fulfillment operations. Leverage AI-assisted sourcing tools to build targeted contributor pipelines efficiently and at scale. Automate repetitive sourcing activities, including talent targeting, profile identification, and skills mapping. Develop and maintain automated dashboards and reports to track recruitment funnels, conversion rates, and fulfillment progress. Identify operational bottlenecks and implement scalable solutions that improve efficiency, accuracy, and productivity. Document workflows, establish best practices, and support team members in adopting new tools and processes. Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to identify automation opportunities and continuously improve operational performance. Success in this role means building reliable, scalable automations that reduce manual work, improve operational efficiency, and enable our Fulfillment team to meet growing project demands. What You Bring 2+ years of experience in operations, process improvement, data analysis, automation, or a related field, ideally within AI, technology, marketplace, or high-growth environments. Demonstrated experience identifying inefficiencies, improving business processes, and transforming manual workflows into scalable solutions. Strong hands-on experience using AI models and tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, or similar platforms to build practical workflows or AI agents. Experience integrating Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools into automation workflows. Strong analytical and data management skills, including proficiency in Excel. Ability to work independently, take ownership of projects, and solve problems in fast-changing environments. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to document processes and support the adoption of new technologies. Curiosity, adaptability, and enthusiasm for exploring emerging AI technologies and applying them to real operational challenges. Nice to Haves Experience with automation platforms or scripting tools such as Python, Google Apps Script, Zapier, Make, or similar. Experience working with APIs, complex JSON data structures, Git, or version control. Knowledge of SQL and data visualization or reporting tools. Experience developing, deploying, or maintaining autonomous AI agents or agentic workflows. Familiarity with AI-powered sourcing, recruitment operations, contributor management, or talent acquisition tools. Experience supporting large-scale, global operations or cross-functional teams. Grow into a presentation/communication-focused role or dive deeper into more-involved technical challenges—the choice is yours. What We're Looking For We're excited to meet candidates who have many of the following qualifications: Must have: Three (3) years of experience illustrating collaboration, passion for data, reliability, precision, curiosity, and respect for teammates and clients. Excellent SQL skills with proven ability to create and evaluate complex SQL statements involving numerous tables and complex relationships. Fluent in Python and experience using common modules (numpy, pandas, statsmodels, matplotlib) for EDA. Experience collaborating with non-technical stakeholders. Nice to have: Working knowledge of statistics and visualization. Experience working with data visualization tools. Advanced Excel skills. Experience using AI coding assistants and building AI-leveraged workflows. Experience working in the healthcare industry. Experience presenting data to a non-technical audience. The Core Values of the Client Intelligence team As an organization we value diversity - in backgrounds and in experiences. Healthcare is a universal concern, and we need people from all backgrounds to help build a better future for all. Below are additional core values specific to the Insights Team. Collaboration —The best candidates and teammates are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth. Passion for Data —You’re going to help our clients and team members with data-driven decision making. We need someone that can manipulate millions of rows of data and also ask the right questions to find the important insights. Reliability – Our team is efficient, flexible, and agile only because we trust the reliability of each member. We need self-starters and goal-oriented individuals for our continued success. Precision – Our team's deliverables power client analysis and inform real-world decisions. A successful candidate will triple check their work and their teammates' work, holding all of us to the highest data quality standards. Curiosity – Continuous learning is a cornerstone at Doximity, and curious individuals thrive in our environment. We’re looking for someone who is curious enough about data to go above-and-beyond the task for the true insight. Respect – A key dynamic that allows our team to flourish is respect: for ourselves and our quality of work, for our teammates, and for our internal clients who are under the pressure of deadlines and finance goals. Why You'll Love Working Here At Doximity, you'll join a mission-driven company where your work has a meaningful impact on healthcare. We believe great ideas come from empowered teams, and we're committed to creating an environment where people can do their best work. Make a real impact. Help build products that support over a million healthcare professionals and ultimately improve patient care. Work with exceptional teammates. Collaborate with thoughtful, talented colleagues who value curiosity, humility, and continuous learning. Enjoy flexibility and trust. We support flexible ways of working and empower employees with the autonomy to own their work. Grow your career. Take on meaningful challenges, develop new skills, and shape your career through mentorship and professional development. Bring your authentic self. We're committed to fostering an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives are welcomed, respected, and celebrated. Our Hiring Process & AI Tools Doximity may use artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled tools throughout the hiring process to help improve the candidate experience and support our recruiting team. These tools may assist with administrative tasks such as scheduling, general communication, interview coordination, note-taking, or summarizing interview feedback. Human recruiters and hiring managers make all hiring decisions. We are committed to using AI responsibly, transparently, and in accordance with applicable laws. Equal Employment Opportunity Doximity is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know so we can support your participation. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/doximity-business-intelligence-analyst-contractor

items.title: Senior Agentic AI Engineer NDA
items.summary: GT was founded in 2019 by a former Apple, Nest, and Google executive. Â GTâs mission is to connect the worldâs best talent with product careers offered by high-growth companies in the UK, USA, Canada, Germany, and the Netherlands. On behalf of the client, GT is looking for a Senior Agentic AI Engineer who is interested in solving complex matching and search problems at scale, applying ML and algorithms to hundreds of millions of real-world data records. Â About the Client Our client is a leading global management consultancy known for tackling some of the worldâs most complex business challenges. With a focus on strategy, transformation, and performance improvement, the firm partners with major organizations across industries to drive lasting impact. Recognized consistently as a top workplace, it combines deep industry expertise with a collaborative, innovative culture. Its centralized European hub plays a key role in supporting operations across the EMEA region, ensuring excellence and efficiency at scale. Â About the Project & Role We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to help design, build, and evolve an AI-powered conversational analytics platform that enables businesses to explore their data, generate insights and visualizations, and make data-driven decisions. The product helps users analyze promotional performance, answer complex analytical questions, build charts and tables, and generate evidence-based recommendations using LLMs, agentic workflows, and governed client data. The team is developing a scalable, secure, and extensible agentic AI framework that can be customized for different clients and integrated with other products through standards such as Model Context Protocol (MCP). The existing solution is built on LangChain, with plans to evolve and migrate the framework. This is a hands-on engineering role with a significant architecture and system design component. You will work across the entire agentic AI lifecycle, from designing agent workflows, tools, and integrations to implementing evaluation frameworks, improving reliability, and delivering production-ready AI features. Responsibilities Design, build, and evolve agentic AI workflows for data exploration, analysis, and conversational insights. Develop and improve an extensible agentic framework , including orchestration, reusable tools, skills, and conversation management. Build secure integrations with application services and governed data sources, including sandboxed code execution and AI-powered data visualizations. Design configurable solutions supporting client-specific prompts, tools, skills, and data definitions without duplicating the core architecture. Develop MCP servers and clients to enable communication and data exchange between agents and applications. Contribute to architectural decisions and the evolution and migration of the existing LangChain-based solution . Implement LLM evaluation, testing, observability, and security controls to ensure accurate, reliable, and data-grounded AI outputs. Own features end to end, from technical design and implementation to production release and continuous improvement, collaborating with cross-functional teams. Essential Knowledge, Skills & Experience Core Requirements 6+ years of experience in software engineering, data analytics, or related fields, including 2+ years in agentic AI engineering . Strong Python development skills, with experience building, testing, and maintaining production-grade applications. Hands-on experience building agentic AI systems using frameworks such as Pydantic AI, LangGraph, LangChain, or OpenAI Agents SDK. Strong understanding of agentic patterns, including tool calling, multi-step orchestration, context management, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop workflows. Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and multi-agent or cross-application integrations. Experience developing AI agents for data analysis, including dataset exploration, code generation and execution, and result interpretation. Strong system design and architecture skills, including building configurable, extensible solutions and evaluating technical trade-offs. Understanding of AI security, evaluation, and observability, including secure data access, LLM testing, tracing, and performance monitoring. Strong ownership, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with practical experience using AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Codex, or similar). Strongly Preferred Experience with Pydantic AI / Pydantic AI Harness and LangChain , particularly migration between frameworks. Familiarity with SQL, pandas, DuckDB, or Ibis for data analysis. Experience with Azure OpenAI, Docker, and analytical visualization tools such as Plotly or Dash. Nice-to-Have Experience with retail, pricing, promotions analytics, or similar domains. Experience delivering client-facing AI products from prototype to production. Familiarity with React and FastAPI. Interview Process Interview with GT Recruiter Cultural Fit Interview Technical Interview Final Interview Offer Why Join Our Client? Join a globally recognized consulting firm building innovative AI-powered products that solve real business problems. Help shape the architecture and technical direction of an evolving agentic AI platform . Build production AI solutions where accuracy, data security, and reliability are essential. Work with modern AI technologies and development tools, including Pydantic AI, MCP, Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenAI Codex . Collaborate with experienced engineers and product teams in an environment that encourages experimentation, continuous improvement, and technical ownership. Please mention the word **UNCOMPLICATED** and tag RNTIuMTczLjE4MS4xMzI= when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RNTIuMTczLjE4MS4xMzI=). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Philippines URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/dcaVtKQqXr9FwBNppNCBH9/jobs-at-d2b Position: Senior Performance Marketing Manager Salary: PHP 80,000 to PHP 120,000/monthly Working Hours & Conditions: Sydney, AU Business Hours and Holidays Employment: Full Time - Independent Contractor ABOUT THE COMPANY: The company is an integrated property and place marketing agency combining brand strategy, high-end creative, and performance-driven lead generation. Our client portfolio primarily consists of leading Australian property developers marketing off-the-plan residential communities, completed luxury stock, and premium commercial assets. We believe true marketing effectiveness requires total alignment across creative narrative, digital targeting, technical attribution, and sales enablement. ROLE OVERVIEW: We are seeking an autonomous, hands-on Senior Performance Marketing Manager to take full operational ownership of paid advertising across our client roster. In this role, you will steer paid media strategy and day-to-day execution across Meta Ads and Google Search, scaling an account base expected to expand to approximately seven multi-channel client accounts in early 2027. Operating alongside our senior strategy, video, and design directors, you will look beyond basic surface metrics to optimize the entire acquisition funnel. Your core mandate is turning paid traffic into qualified buyer enquiries, booked display suite appointments, and closed developer sales. RESPONSIBILITIES: Paid Media Execution & Management: Architect, launch, and optimize high-converting Meta Ads and Google Search campaigns. Manage budget pacing, audience segmentation, bid strategies, search queries, and negative keyword lists. Maintain meticulous account hygiene, access controls, billing protocols, naming conventions, and policy compliance. Creative Strategy & Iterative Testing: Translate high-level project personas, narrative angles, and visual hooks into rigorous creative testing frameworks. Set minimum spend thresholds, monitor fatigue indicators, and deliver structured briefs to internal design and video teams for iterations, variations, and net-new creative concepts. Tracking, Attribution & Offline Data: Set up, audit, and troubleshoot tracking architecture via GA4, Google Tag Manager (GTM), Meta Pixel, and Conversions API (CAPI). Integrate CRM data pipelines to enable closed-loop offline conversion tracking. Data Visualization & Client Reporting: Build and manage Looker Studio dashboards demonstrating true acquisition ROI, downstream appointment volume, and sales conversion rates. Deliver structured weekly written updates detailing performance drivers, strategic shifts, and upcoming optimizations. Conversion Rate Optimization & Funnel Operations: Audit full user journeys from click to qualification, proposing ongoing landing page enhancements. Execute technical SEO and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) initiatives in coordination with senior leadership, including site speed fixes and email nurture workflows. AI Workflow Integration: Leverage AI tools across daily operations, data analysis, reporting synthesis, and rapid creative ideation. Develop and document standard operating procedures that leverage AI to increase throughput without compromising quality or strategic rigor. Agency & Account Scale: Minimum of 5 years of direct, hands-on performance marketing experience, with a proven track record managing multi-client portfolios within an agency setting. Channel Mastery: Deep, current technical proficiency in Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads (Search). Downstream Conversion Focus: Demonstrated history driving high-intent B2C or high-consideration lead generation, measuring success by sales outcomes rather than raw lead volume. Technical Infrastructure: Hands-on experience configuring GA4, GTM, Meta CAPI, offline conversion feeds, and custom Looker Studio dashboards. Attribution Acumen: Solid understanding of multi-touch attribution, channel mix modeling constraints, and cross-platform reporting discrepancies. AI Fluency: Active, daily integration of AI workflows into campaign development, copy iteration, or analytical operations. Communication & Cadence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; ability to produce executive-ready client summaries and precise creative briefs. Operational Alignment: Full availability to work aligned with Sydney, Australia (AEST/AEDT) business hours. Preferred Conversion Optimization: Practical expertise in landing page design principles, conversion rate optimization (CRO), and site speed auditing. Modern Search: Exposure to technical SEO execution and AI search optimization (AEO/GEO). Vertical Experience: Prior exposure to Australian real estate, specifically residential off-the-plan project marketing. Lifecycle Marketing: Hands-on automation experience configuring email qualification funnels in platforms such as Zoho or Brevo. What You’ll Bring Full-Funnel Ownership: A commercial mindset that views media spend as an investment engine tied directly to pipeline appointments and revenue. Analytical Independence: The confidence to diagnose sudden performance shifts, troubleshoot faulty tracking scripts, and proactively bring solutions rather than problems. Creative Curiosity: The ability to decipher why specific visual hooks work, bridging data analysis with sharp creative direction. Process Rigor: Strong personal project management, high attention to operational detail, and the discipline to maintain structured experiments across dynamic accounts. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/d2b-senior-performance-marketing-manager-dayshift-remote

items.description: Hey there! We’re Fever , the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment. Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment. Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences. Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right? To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment! Ready to be part of the experience? Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission. About the Role At Fever , we are building a federated data organization that combines centralization where it’s essential and autonomy where it creates value. Our teams leverage modern data platforms (Snowflake, DBT, Airflow, DataHub, Metabase, etc.). At the same time, we are developing our own technology to deliver high-quality data products across multiple business domains. As a Senior Analytics Engineer , you’ll be the bridge between data engineering and business analytics, ensuring that our stakeholders can make decisions on reliable, well-modeled, and discoverable datasets. What You’ll Do Design, build, and maintain data models (DBT, SQL) that transform raw data into clean, trusted datasets for self-service and reporting. Collaborate with the data engineering team to define and certify business-critical metrics (revenue, engagement, marketing performance, B2B KPIs, etc.). Work with business squads (B2B, Marketing, CRM, Product) to understand their needs and turn them into reusable data assets. Ensure data quality and consistency , partnering with the data engineering team on testing frameworks, observability, and governance. Support self-service analytics by enabling stakeholders to explore data confidently by leveraging existing viz and BI tools or driving custom developments to let the data tell a complete story. Contribute to Airflow pipelines in Python , supporting automation and orchestration needs. Contribute to our data mesh vision , creating domain-owned datasets while following platform and engineering guidelines. Leverage Agentic AI , Claude Code, and other advanced AI tools in your day-to-day workflow to accelerate development cycles, boost efficiency, and maximize your overall impact. What You Bring Fluent in Spanish and English ; you’ll communicate in Spanish with local teams and in English with global teams A Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Computer Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Science, or a related field. A collaborative mindset: comfortable working with both engineers and business stakeholders. Strong communication skills, adaptable to a multidisciplinary, international, and fast-paced environment. A keen interest in understanding a complex business landscape and to drive the company forward by providing the data to answer the most valuable questions Strong experience with SQL and data modeling (star/snowflake schemas, data vault, or similar). Hands-on experience with DBT (or similar transformation frameworks). Hands-on experience with Python and orchestration frameworks (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect). Familiarity with modern cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, etc.). Experience with BI tools (Metabase, Superset, Tableau, etc.). Understanding of data quality, governance, and observability practices. Nice to Have Experience in a federated or data mesh environment . Familiarity with data catalog tools (DataHub, Collibra, Amundsen). Exposure to analytics in domains like marketing, CRM, or B2B reporting . Hands-on experience or strong interest in leveraging Agentic AI and coding assistants (like Claude Code or Copilot) to accelerate data workflows and development. Benefits & Perks Attractive compensation package consisting of base salary and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance Stock options Responsibility from day one and professional and personal growth Opportunity to have a real impact in a high-growth global category leader 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences Home office friendly Health insurance and other benefits such as Flexible remuneration with a 100% tax exemption through Cobee English Lessons Gympass Membership Possibility to receive in advance part of your salary by Payflow Interview Process The interview process will be conducted in Spanish; however, some interviews will require English. Talent Interview Technical Interview (90') Manager Interview Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you! If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | Tech.Eu | TechCrunch Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply! If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey. If you want to know more about how Fever processes your personal data, click here Fever - Candidate Privacy Notice

items.summary: Job Summary:We are seeking a talented Data Scientist to join our remote team.
items.description: Job Summary: We are seeking a talented Data Scientist to join our remote team. As a Data Scientist, you will be responsible for analyzing complex datasets, developing machine learning models, and deriving actionable insights to drive business decisions. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in statistics, machine learning, and programming, along with the ability to work independently in a remote environment. This is an exciting opportunity to apply your skills to real-world problems and contribute to innovative projects from anywhere in the world. Responsibilities: Analyze large datasets to extract meaningful patterns, trends, and insights using statistical techniques and machine learning algorithms. Develop predictive models and algorithms to solve business problems and optimize decision-making processes. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define project objectives, gather requirements, and prioritize tasks. Clean, preprocess, and manipulate data to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency for analysis. Build and deploy machine learning models into production environments, and monitor their performance over time. Interpret and communicate analysis results and insights to stakeholders through visualizations, reports, and presentations. Stay updated with the latest developments in data science, machine learning, and AI technologies, and apply them to improve existing models and methodologies. Conduct experiments and A/B tests to evaluate model performance and validate hypotheses. Mentor junior data scientists and provide guidance on best practices in data analysis and modeling. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or related field; Master's or Ph.D. degree is a plus. Minimum of 3 years of experience in data science, machine learning, or related fields. Proficiency in programming languages such as Python or R, along with experience with data manipulation and analysis libraries (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn). Strong understanding of statistical concepts and methods, and experience with hypothesis testing, regression analysis, and time series forecasting. Hands-on experience with machine learning techniques such as classification, regression, clustering, and natural language processing. Familiarity with data visualization tools and techniques (e.g., Matplotlib, Seaborn, Tableau). Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, and proficiency in SQL and NoSQL databases. Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail, with the ability to work independently and as part of a remote team. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to effectively communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. #DataScientist #RemoteWork #MachineLearning #DataAnalysis #DataScience #RemoteJob #AI #PredictiveModeling #DataMining #Statistics #RemoteTech #WorkFromAnywhere #TechJobs #DataAnalytics #ArtificialIntelligence #Python #RemoteOpportunity Originally posted on Himalayas

Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomou
items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: US, Remote URL: http://horizon3.ai Get to Know Us Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results. What You'll Do Investigate complex failures across the entire stack. A single case might take you from Kubernetes pod scheduling, through container networking, into cloud IAM permissions, and into our application logs in Datadog. You own the investigation end to end. Be the technical bridge between customers and engineering. You'll translate customer-reported symptoms into actionable bug reports with reproduction steps, logs, and root cause hypotheses. When engineering ships a fix, you verify it actually solves the problem in the customer's environment. Build tooling and automation. If you're doing something manually more than twice, you build a tool. We need someone who writes Python scripts, builds internal dashboards, automates data collection from Zendesk and Jira, and creates runbooks that make the whole team more effective. Drive systemic improvements. You'll spot patterns across tickets that point to product gaps, documentation holes, or infrastructure reliability issues. You bring the data, make the case, and work with engineering and product to fix the root cause, not just the symptom. Go deep on web application security. Our platform now does web app pentesting. You need to understand common vulnerability classes (OWASP top 10), how web scanners work, and how to explain findings and their implications to customers who range from security experts to IT generalists. Mentor the team and raise the technical bar. You'll help junior and senior engineers develop their troubleshooting skills, create training content, and establish patterns for how the team approaches complex investigations. What We're Looking For Must have: 8+ years of hands-on technical experience. The title on your resume matters less than what you've actually done. We'll take an SRE who built incident response tooling, a backend developer who ran production infrastructure, or a support engineer who can write real code and read Terraform. Strong Linux fundamentals. You're comfortable on a command line, can troubleshoot a hung process on RHEL, understand SELinux, and don't need a GUI to be productive. Container and Kubernetes experience. You've deployed and troubleshot containerized workloads. You know the difference between a CrashLoopBackOff and an ImagePullBackOff and what to do about each. Cloud platform experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP). You understand IAM, networking (VPCs, security groups, firewalls), and have worked with Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation) -- not just reading plans, but writing and debugging them when provisioning fails. GraphQL and web application fluency. Our API is GraphQL. You can trace a request from a React frontend through the GraphQL layer to the backend, interpret query/mutation responses (including partial errors in a 200), and debug auth flows, CORS issues, and network failures using browser dev tools. Database fundamentals. You can write SQL to investigate data issues, understand relational and NoSQL concepts, and ideally have exposure to graph databases -- our product maps attack paths and relationships that are naturally graph-shaped. Scripting ability in Python and Bash. You've built automation that other people actually use, not just one-off scripts for yourself. Observability tool experience (Datadog preferred). You can search logs, build queries, read traces, and correlate signals across services to find where something broke. Strong communication skills. You'll write to customers, file bugs for engineering, and present findings to product. Each audience needs a different approach and you adjust naturally. Big pluses: Background in cybersecurity, pentesting, or AppSec. Understanding of common exploit classes, vulnerability assessment, and security tooling. Experience with web application security. Familiar with XSS, SQLi, SSRF, auth bypass, IDOR, and how WAFs and CDNs affect security testing. Active Directory experience. Many of our customers' environments are AD-heavy, and NodeZero tests AD attack paths (password audits, credential attacks, privilege escalation). Understanding AD architecture, GPOs, trusts, and common misconfigurations is a real advantage. Full-stack development experience. You've shipped production code in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Go. Deep graph database experience (Neo4j or similar). Our attack path data is graph-native -- if you can write Cypher queries and understand graph traversal, you'll hit the ground running. Certifications (AWS SA Pro, CKA, RHCE, OSCP, or similar). Not required, but signals self-direction and depth. Experience in regulated environments (SOC 2, FedRAMP, GDPR). Useful given our customer base. Travel Required We are a fully remote company, and this job may require up to 5% of travel to be successful. Perks of Horizon3 Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.
