The successful candidate will bring proven expertise in affiliate marketing within iGaming globally, a strong network of partners, and the commercial acumen to drive measurable acquisition and retention results. This role is ideal for a hands-on, entrepreneurial professional eager to make a direct impact in a startup environment. Location: Fully Remote Responsibilities: As Director of Affiliates , your broad responsibilities will include but are not limited to: Own the affiliate budget and investment strategy. Develop and execute the affiliate acquisition and growth strategy for a new market launch, focusing on quality traffic and long-term ROI. Build, manage, and nurture strong relationships with key affiliates and media partners. Negotiate competitive commercial agreements and commission structures to maximise profitability. Monitor, analyse, and optimize affiliate performance against KPIs including FTDs, eCPA, and LTV. Collaborate closely with internal teams (product, CRM, content, design) to deliver affiliates the creative assets, insights, and campaigns they need to succeed. Stay ahead of market trends, competitor activity, and emerging opportunities within the iGaming space. Develop forecasting models for acquisition, CPA, revenue share, and player value. Build reporting frameworks and dashboards to drive data-led decision making. Analyse traffic quality, player cohorts, retention trends, and LTV across affiliate partners. Make commercial recommendations based on performance data and market opportunities. Establish KPI frameworks for affiliate performance and partner profitability. Requirements: Minimum 5+ years’ experience in affiliate management within iGaming, with proven success in the online casino vertical. Established network of affiliates and media partners across regulated, emerging, and pre-regulated markets. In-depth understanding of affiliate KPIs, commercial deal structures, and performance optimisation. Experience launching, scaling, and optimising affiliate programmes across emerging and newly regulated markets. Strong understanding of market-entry strategies, player acquisition economics, and traffic diversification across multiple jurisdictions. Strong analytical and commercial mindset, with the ability to combine performance data, player value metrics, and market insights to drive strategic decisions. Entrepreneurial approach, self-starter mentality, and comfort working in a fast-paced startup environment. Experience working closely with BI and CRM teams to evaluate traffic quality and long-term player value. Proven ability to identify and capitalize on new growth opportunities in markets with varying levels of regulatory maturity. Extensive experience negotiating and managing commercial agreements with a broad range of affiliate and media partners. This is an exceptional opportunity to apply your expertise and contribute to the success of a high-performing organisation with a global presence. What we offer: Competitive Compensation: You will receive a highly competitive compensation package, which includes a competitive base salary, performance bonuses, and other incentives, all reflective of your experience and contribution. Work-Life Balance: We value work-life balance and offer flexible working arrangements, recognising that achieving your best in your career requires a healthy balance between work and personal life. items.description: About Hello Heart: Hello Heart is on a mission to make heart attacks a thing of the past. We’re an AI company focused exclusively on heart health, building a platform that predicts and prevents cardiac events before they happen—identifying risk up to 10 days in advance versus 10 years in traditional clinical models. This is already working at scale. Hello Heart has been shown to reduce inpatient hospital days by 47% and deliver ~$1,800 in annual savings per member. Hello Heart is the cardiac prevention partner to over 80% of large U.S. health plans and serves hundreds of public and private employers. We’re defining how the #1 cause of death—heart disease—is managed in the AI era. Join us. About the Role At Hello Heart, we empower people to understand and improve their heart health through technology and behavioral science. As Director, Global Supply Chain, you will own sourcing execution, supplier performance, component lifecycle risk, demand and supply planning, and sales and operations planning for our global electronics supply chain. Reporting to our Director, Global Supply Management and Logistics, you will be a hands-on individual contributor. You will recommend supply strategies, execute approved plans, negotiate with manufacturers across Asia-Pacific, and partner with Engineering, Quality, Regulatory, Commercial, Finance, and Operations to balance availability, cost, quality, and working capital. Responsibilities Source, evaluate, and onboard electronics manufacturers and component suppliers, especially in China, Taiwan, and Vietnam. Lead competitive bids, due diligence, supplier qualification, agreements, and launch readiness. Own supplier performance for cost, quality, delivery, and capacity. Lead quarterly reviews, scorecards, corrective actions, escalations, and recovery plans. Own bill of materials sourcing data, approved sources, pricing, lead times, and lifecycle risks. Coordinate alternate components, last-time buys, and manufacturing transitions with Engineering, Quality, and Regulatory. Monitor factory capacity, yields, and build readiness. Partner with Logistics on shipment planning, fulfillment handoffs, relabeling, and repackaging. Recommend and execute multi-year sourcing plans for supplier diversification, geographic redundancy, capacity, tooling, cost, and continuity. Negotiate pricing and commercial terms using should-cost, bill of materials, and landed-cost analysis. Drive savings, secure required approvals, and protect quality and launch timelines. Manage risks from Asia-Pacific lead times, freight, tariffs, customs, supplier finances, and geopolitical changes. Develop alternatives and inventory or capacity buffers with clear tradeoffs. Manage supplier contracts, purchasing commitments, renewals, approvals, and records with Legal and Finance, including quality agreements, tooling ownership, and inventory liability. Own a rolling 24-month demand and supply plan using client launches, eligible populations, campaigns, conversion, seasonality, and replacements. Model upside and downside scenarios. Translate demand into component, production, capacity, purchasing, inventory, and delivery plans; reconcile supplier commitments, open orders, and in-transit supply. Lead monthly sales and operations planning and weekly execution reviews. Build dashboards for forecast accuracy, supply adherence, inventory health, and supplier performance; drive decisions and follow-through. Qualifications 10+ years of global electronics sourcing, supplier management, and supply planning experience, including negotiations and execution. Direct experience with Asia-Pacific electronics factories, component suppliers, manufacturing lead times, freight, tariffs, customs, and Incoterms; willingness to work across time zones and travel internationally. Expertise in bills of materials, component lifecycle management, supplier qualification, forecasting, inventory, capacity planning, and sales and operations planning. Proven supplier performance improvement, cross-functional influence, cost analysis, and commercial negotiation skills. Proficiency with enterprise resource planning and material requirements planning systems, spreadsheets, financial models, and dashboards. Experience using or customizing AI agents and repeatable workflows for planning, reporting, and supplier follow-up, with output validation and human review. Preferred Qualifications Certified in Planning and Inventory Management or Certified Supply Chain Professional certification. Experience with regulated electronics or medical devices, Food and Drug Administration supplier controls, and manufacturing diversification in Mexico. Experience forecasting enrollment-driven demand for employer or health-plan programs. The US base salary range for this full-time position is $155,000.00 to $170,000.00. Salary ranges are determined by role and level. Compensation is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the salary only, and do not include equity or benefits. Hello Heart has a positive, diverse, and supportive culture - we look for people who are collaborative, creative, and courageous. Oh, and if you want to see some recent evidence of the fun things we do at Hello Heart, check out our Instagram page.

items.description: Flex is building the AI-native private bank for business owners . We’re re-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs—from the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, and financial operations—rebuilt from the ground up as a single, intelligent system. Flex is the full financial home for ambitious owners. Since launching publicly in September 2023 , Flex has scaled from zero to nine-figure annualized revenue , with a clear path to profitability by late 2026 . We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership. Our customers are affluent business owners ($3–$200M in revenue) —the backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. They’re stuck with outdated banks and fragmented tools. We’re replacing all of it. The opportunity is massive: a ~$1T+ revenue market hiding in plain sight. Our ambition is to build a $100B+ company by delivering a product that is fundamentally better—not incrementally improved. Flex has raised $100M+ in equity and $300M+ in debt. - Mission-critical problems : We build software that directly controls how money moves at scale. - High bar, low ego : Small teams, exceptional people, real ownership. - Speed over comfort : We prioritize execution, quality, clarity, and results. - Enduring impact : What we’re building will define how a generation of owners runs their businesses. Team & Locations We hire exceptional people who want to build hard things and see their work matter immediately. Roles are available in: San Francisco, Miami, New York, and fully remote. Flex Fuels Ambition. About the Role We are seeking an energetic and intellectually curious Analytics professional with domain expertise in credit analytics and a strong grasp of financial data interpretation. The ideal candidate will be comfortable working with varied datasets to derive insights for both credit underwriting and ongoing portfolio management. This role will play a critical part in improving credit decisions, monitoring customer behavior, and informing risk management and product strategy. What You'll Do New Account Evaluation Analyze new applicant data to support automated and manual credit decisioning. Work with data extracted from business financial statements, tax documents, and banking integrations (e.g., Quickbooks, Netsuite, Plaid, etc). Leverage insights from adjacent product usage (e.g., business banking, payments platforms) to evaluate risk profiles. Build dashboards or tools to surface real-time indicators for underwriting and fraud detection. Existing Account Management Monitor account-level behavior post-origination, including spend and payment patterns, credit utilization, and engagement. Identify signs of weakening creditworthiness using internal data and third-party credit reports (e.g., Experian, D&B). Track and analyze delinquency trends and payment consistency to refine risk models and collections strategies. Develop behavioral segments and performance cohorts for proactive account management. Credit Product P&L Understanding Support P&L analysis of the unsecured credit card product, including interchange income, interest revenue, rewards cost, and charge-off rates. Build models to evaluate customer lifetime value, profitability segmentation, and risk-adjusted returns. Assist in identifying drivers of loss and opportunities for margin improvement. Requirements 5+ years of experience in a data analytics or credit analytics role, preferably within fintech, credit cards, or SMB lending. Fluency in SQL / SAS and comfort with Python or R for exploratory data analysis and automation. Strong understanding of credit underwriting principles and SMB financial analysis. Experience interpreting business financials (P&L, balance sheet, tax returns) and cash flow data from banking sources. Familiarity with credit bureau data and commercial credit reports. Ability to communicate findings clearly and influence cross-functional stakeholders. Compensation Final compensation within this range will be based on experience, qualifications, and interview performance. This position is also eligible for equity compensation. Flex offers medical, dental and vision insurance, paid time off, and a 401(k) plan. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. Additional Information Why Join Us Build something generational — Capture the full lifecycle of money for ambitious business owners. Work on real money, real risk — Payments, credit, and banking at serious scale. Solve hard problems — AI, underwriting, compliance, and global finance from first principles. True ownership — Small teams, high trust, real accountability. Founder-level exposure — Direct access to leadership, customers, and investors. High bar, high taste — Move fast without cutting corners. Elite peers — People here are builders, not tourists. Real upside — Meaningful equity if you help build something big.

items.description: At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most. We are seeking a highly motivated and analytical individual to join our Growth Analytics International team. This team plays a crucial role in conducting research, monitoring performance, and running experiments to develop exceptional products for both consumers and merchants while driving long-term growth for the business. As Affirm continues expanding into new international markets, this role will be instrumental in establishing the operational analytics framework for new launches, beginning with Australia and expanding into future international markets. The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, a collaborative mindset, an eagerness to learn, and the patience to tackle complex challenges. Our team takes an end-to-end business analytics perspective, partnering across the organization to develop recommendations and solutions that enable the business to successfully execute its growth and profitability strategies. This role requires someone who can combine analytical rigor with business acumen to influence decisions and drive measurable outcomes. What you’ll do Establish and evolve the operational analytics framework for new international markets, ensuring scalable measurement, reporting, and decision-making capabilities as we expand globally. Operate with a business owner mindset by proactively identifying opportunities through analysis and product sense to enhance user experience, growth, and profitability. Own business problems from end to end by translating analytical insights into recommendations and optimization strategies that support business growth, profitability, and operational excellence. Take ownership of the end-to-end analytics process: define success metrics, generate insights and hypotheses, track performance, and create intuitive dashboards and reports that can be easily shared across the organization. Develop scalable analytics solutions and data models. Tackle ambiguous problems by identifying the core hypotheses and designing actionable experiments to validate product-market fit and economic viability. Translate analytical findings into clear and compelling narratives and business cases for leadership to inform decision-making. Spearhead weekly cross-functional metric reviews, collaborating with partners to conduct deep dives into significant metric shifts and suggest actionable steps. Partner effectively across Product, Risk, Finance, Commercial, and Operations to align strategies and execute against business objectives. Foster strong cross-functional relationships and establish yourself as a trusted advisor to team members. Mentor and guide junior analysts to deliver high-impact work that drives business results. What we look for: Passion to redefine the lending and financial industry for the better. Strong understanding of the consumer lending and credit industry, including lending economics, portfolio performance, and credit metrics. Experience supporting international lending markets, particularly Europe and/or APAC, is highly desirable. Demonstrated ability to balance growth objectives with profitability and develop data-driven growth strategies. Bachelor's or Master's degree in a quantitatively rigorous subject area such as statistics, mathematics, finance, or economics. 5+ years of proven success in a cross-functional analytical role. Practical and theoretical knowledge of A/B testing. Experience with SQL and performing statistical analysis using Python. Experience simultaneously balancing multiple workstreams and prioritizing an analytics roadmap. Demonstrated curiosity and a growth mindset, with hands-on experience using AI-powered tools such as Cursor, Claude, or similar assistants to accelerate analysis, automate workflows, enhance problem-solving, and advocate for AI adoption across analytical workflows. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to influence both technical and non-technical audiences. Comfortable partnering across multiple cross-functional teams, particularly Product, Risk, Commercial, Finance, and Operations. Ability to think creatively and critically while thriving in a fast-paced, dynamic, and often ambiguous work environment. Willingness to go out of your way to help teammates, with humility and a team-first mindset. Previous experience mentoring and guiding junior analysts. Compensation & Benefits Pay Grade - M Equity Grade - 5 Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range . Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills. items.description: this is your role At TradeTracker .com, we are dedicated to delivering innovative software solutions that meet the needs of our clients and drive business growth. We are seeking an experienced Product Development Manager with a strong foundation in Advertising Technology (3+ years) and demonstrated leadership in SaaS product development . Your cover letter must highlight relevant adtech, SaaS, and gamification experience, demonstrating why these make you an exceptional fit for this role. Applications missing this information cannot be processed. Key Responsibilities As a Product Development Manager, you will be at the forefront of our product innovation. Your primary responsibility is to ensure that our products are designed and developed to meet the highest standards of quality and performance. You will lead efforts to understand market demands, identify opportunities for improvement, and work with various teams to deliver solutions that enhance our product offerings. You will report directly to the Head of Product, ensuring alignment with overall company goals and strategy. Product Design and Documentation: Actively create and maintain clear, detailed documentation for new products and features, including functional descriptions, flowcharts, and mockups. You will translate complex product ideas into easy-to-understand visuals and written materials, providing a blueprint that guides development and enhances cross-functional understanding. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including developers, data engineers, and product managers, to deliver high-impact products. Your role will involve coordinating efforts across these teams to ensure that product development is seamless and efficient, fostering a collaborative environment. Product-Market Fit: Continuously assess and address client needs to ensure that our products maintain their relevance and effectiveness in the market. This involves staying updated on market trends, gathering client feedback, and making data-driven decisions to refine and improve our products. You will also need to understand SaaS interfaces, dashboards, charts, and reports to create user-friendly and insightful products. your profile To excel in this role, you need a blend of experience, technical knowledge, and analytical skills. These qualifications will enable you to understand the market, make informed decisions, and drive the development of successful products. Experience: Proven experience as a Product Manager or in a similar role within the advertising or software development fields. You should have a track record of successfully managing and launching products that meet market needs and drive business growth. SaaS Expertise: Good understanding of SaaS interfaces, dashboards, charts, and reports. This expertise is essential for developing user-friendly products that provide valuable insights and drive user engagement. AdTech Knowledge: A deep understanding of the online advertising technology landscape, including customer needs and market dynamics. Experience and knowledge in AdTech and online advertising are crucial. Knowledge and experience with affiliate marketing are a plus. Analytical Skills: Strong ability to analyze market data, interpret insights, and make informed decisions. This involves using data to prioritize product features, measure performance, and guide the product development process. You should also be comfortable with SaaS analytics and reporting tools to extract meaningful insights. Rapid Prototyping: Knowledge and experience with rapid prototyping techniques to quickly iterate and refine product concepts. This is crucial for fast-paced development cycles and ensuring that ideas are effectively translated into functional designs. We are looking for someone who not only meets the skill requirements but also brings additional qualities that will help drive our success. Your proficiency with tools, experience in scope management, and ability to lead and inspire are critical for this role. Product Management Tools: Proficient in using product management tools and methodologies such as Atlassian Product Discovery. These tools help streamline the product development process, ensure all team members are aligned, and facilitate efficient project management. Scope Management: Experience in transferring scope from Product Management to Product Owners for product development. This skill ensures that product development is focused and efficient, with clear responsibilities and timelines, leading to successful project execution. Wireframing & Prototyping: Familiarity with high-level wireframing and prototyping techniques. This allows you to create initial design concepts that can be tested and refined before full-scale development, ensuring that the final product meets user needs and expectations. Productivity & Quality: We expect high productivity and a work mentality based on productivity-focused work. Your performance should consistently result in high-quality products that are superior to those offered by our competitors. Visionary Thinker: A forward-thinking leader with the ability to inspire people and drive teams toward achieving strategic goals. Your vision and leadership will be crucial in guiding the product development process and achieving business objectives. If you are passionate about AdTech and have the expertise to lead product development in a dynamic environment, we would love to hear from you. At TradeTracker .com, we're a leading global affiliate marketing platform that empowers advertisers and publishers to succeed in the digital marketing landscape. Our cutting-edge technology and commitment to excellence make us the preferred choice for businesses worldwide. Being at the forefront of technology and monetization models, we encourage creativity and a winner’s mindset. Be a part of a leading company in the fast-evolving affiliate marketing landscape. Work in a dynamic, innovative environment where your ideas can truly make a difference. Join a team of passionate professionals dedicated to excellence and continuous improvement. Enjoy a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and a flexible working arrangement. Embrace the opportunity to grow your career in a company that values creativity, innovation, and results. Join our dynamic team at TradeTracker .com and be part of a fast-paced, innovative environment where your skills will be put to the test. If you're passionate about creating products the market want but may not even be aware about, we want to hear from you. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. We’re seeking a Customer Solution Architect Team Lead to captain a high-performing team of Customer Solutions Architects and help drive the adoption of Supabase across a diverse range of customers: from agile startups building towards their first launch to established brands with highly scaled workloads. This role will support the East Coast region across the Americas. As the CSA Team Lead, you will be responsible for both people management and customer outcomes - supporting team execution while developing repeatable best practices across pre-sales discovery, proof-of-value onboarding, and technical success. What You’ll Do At Supabase, CSA Leads oversee a portfolio of high-value customers by empowering their team to deliver technical excellence and long-term customer success. You'll work directly with the team to: Hire, coach, and grow a global team of CSAs who serve as trusted technical advisors to our customers. Collaborate with Sales, Product, and Engineering to define and scale the CSA motion across the full customer journey—from discovery through adoption and renewal. Create structured onboarding, training, and development plans for CSAs to level up in technical storytelling, Postgres optimization, and customer success strategy. Ensure CSAs consistently deliver successful outcomes, unblock adoption, and drive value for paid Team and Enterprise accounts. Work directly with strategic customers when needed—especially during complex escalations, architectural deep dives, or critical onboarding milestones. You'll be joining our team to support Supabase Team & Enterprise customers, where you will be expected to lead and innovate around the following areas of responsibility: Pre-Sales Discovery: Lead and review technical discovery led by CSAs to uncover business and technical objectives, set appropriate expectations of the Supabase platform, and define the criteria for success. Guide CSAs in designing and presenting platform demonstrations tailored to high-value customers, helping them clearly articulate the value of the Supabase platform and team. Collaborate with Growth team members to size deals, provide anticipated usage estimates, and identify potential workloads supported by the Platform. Proof-of-Value Onboarding Support your team in defining and executing proof-of-value scopes that balance business outcomes with low-friction onboarding. Ensure CSA-owned timelines, success criteria, and engagement tactics result in a high proof-to-conversion success rate. Build reusable onboarding flows (email sequences, docs, templates, webinars) that accelerate time-to-value for new customers. Customer Success & Expansion Help your team build detailed account plans focused on both short-term adoption and long-term expansion opportunities. Provide ongoing technical coaching for CSAs conducting architecture reviews, schema design evaluations, and performance tuning for production workloads. Partner cross-functionally to advocate for customer feedback, share emerging customer needs with Product & Eng, and communicate roadmap milestones back to customers. Trust & Platform Advocacy Coach CSAs to act as internal and external champions of Supabase, building trust with customers through consistency, clarity, and deep product expertise. Uphold a standard of excellence in customer engagement, ensuring Supabase becomes embedded in the way our customers build. Preferred Experience 6+ years of experience in Solutions Architecture, Technical Account Management, or Database Engineering. 2+ years of people management or team leadership experience , ideally in a high-growth, technical startup environment. Strong background with relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred), with a deep understanding of schema design, indexing, and query performance. Hands-on experience building modern web applications using frameworks like React, Svelte, Vue, or Node.js. Clear, confident technical communicator and storyteller. Must be able to distill complex technical topics into actionable outcomes for customers and team members alike. Experience navigating stakeholder alignment, conflict resolution, and collaborative problem-solving across teams. Familiarity with tools such as HubSpot, BigQuery, and internal BI dashboards. What We Offer Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. About the Team Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. ~400 team members 60+ countries 20+ languages spoken Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

items.description: Company Description At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients. Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es Why join us? 📊 Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference. 📈 At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on. ✨ Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now and build for long-term success. Job Description You'll run Docplanner's paid search activities for patients across multiple markets, including Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, Chile, Italy, Spain and Poland. You'll manage a large-scale Google Ads setup with 100+ accounts, tens of thousands of campaigns and millions of keywords, working with our in-house ads engine and AI agents. Your responsibilities: Manage and optimise Google Ads campaigns for doctor and clinic profiles across all markets, including campaign structure, bids, budgets, keywords, negatives, ads and ad scheduling. Execute large-scale changes using Google Ads Editor, bulk uploads and scripts. Work with AI agents and automation scripts: review AI-driven changes, handle edge cases and improve automated scripts. Handle requests from country teams, including new activations, budget changes, campaign pauses and custom ads. Monitor daily pacing, cost per booking and campaign health, and act on alerts when needed. Ensure conversion tracking is accurate in collaboration with data and web teams. Manage healthcare advertising policies, certifications and ad disapprovals. Report on performance using SQL queries and dashboards. Qualifications: 6+ years of hands-on Google Ads experience, including managing large, multi-account setups across several markets. Expert knowledge of Google Ads Editor and bulk campaign management. Strong experience building Google Ads scripts and/or working with the Google Ads API, including reading data, modifying scripts and debugging automation. SQL skills, with the ability to independently query a data warehouse (Redshift or similar). Experience with healthcare advertising policies and certifications. Comfortable working with automation and AI tools on a daily basis. Fluent English. Nice to have: Knowledge of Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Polish, Turkish or German. Experience building and scaling large Google Ads accounts. Experience with YouTube, Performance Max or Demand Gen. Background in a marketplace, health tech or subscription-based business. What to Expect from Our Hiring Process We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role): 1️⃣ Intro Chat – A first call with our Talent Partner to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation. 2️⃣ Practical assessment 3️⃣Hiring Manager Interview – A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and experience. Take this chance to ask anything on your mind-it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too. 4️⃣ Additional/ Final Interview - A final conversation with another senior leader from our Global Team. Why You’ll Love It Here 💙 Global Benefits – No matter where you are, you’ll have access to: Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters. Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered. Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance. 📍 Local Perks – Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave. 🚀 Career Growth – We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross-functional projects. 🌎 A Truly Global Team – Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment. ⏳ Flexibility That Works for You – Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You're welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna. Please note: At this time, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position. To apply, you must already have the legal right to work in your country of residence or the location of the role. What We Believe In At Docplanner, our values guide everything we do: 📊 Focus on results – we're here to make an impact. 🧠 Think like an owner – take responsibility, drive outcomes. ✂️ Keep it simple, keep it lean – smart solutions over complexity. 🔊 Be respectful and radically honest – openness builds trust. 📚 Learn and be curious – growth is part of the job. Don’t just take our word for it—check out our Glassdoor to hear what our people say! _________________________________________________________________________ We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We welcome applicants from all walks of life, regardless of gender, disability, or background, and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute.

Backend services, identity, analytics, meta-game sys
items.description: Product Headquarters: Las Vegas, Nevada, United States URL: https://www.skillz.com About Beamable Beamable is the backend and LiveOps infrastructure platform for game developers, the system that lets studios build, operate, and scale live games without constructing the underlying architecture themselves. Backend services, identity, analytics, meta-game systems, virtual economies, and AI-native tooling: all integrated into a single platform that eliminates the point-solution stitching that has defined game development for too long. Beamable also powers Wingman, an agentic LiveOps product that gives game teams a unified operating system to understand, optimize, and act on live game performance in real time. This is the future of how games are operated. Beamable is part of FIRY , a founder-led global technology portfolio operating at the intersection of gaming, AI-powered performance marketing, and developer infrastructure. Acquired in January 2026, and together with Skillz, our competition platform, and RZR , our AI-driven ad network, Beamable sits at the foundation of a compounding ecosystem that no standalone competitor can replicate. If you want to build the infrastructure that games run on at a company with the vision and resources to back it — Beamable is the right place to do it. About the Role Beamable is seeking a Head of Product to shape its platform vision and lead its next phase of growth in the game backend market. This is an opportunity to build the product function from the ground up, guide the platform from early access through public release, and advance AI integration to deliver meaningful value for game studios. As the company’s senior product leader and sole product practitioner, you will own product strategy, roadmap, launch milestones, and success metrics, combining strategic direction with hands-on execution. You will work directly with studios and design partners, represent Beamable’s product vision at industry events, and translate customer insights into clear priorities. Success in this role means delivering a successful public launch, developing early-access studios into reference customers, and establishing a product foundation that drives adoption and sustained revenue growth. Responsibilities Product Strategy & Vision Ownership. Set the product vision for Beamable’s platform — spanning player engagement, developer tools, data enrichment, and player intelligence — and own the roadmap from early access through public release and beyond. Partner with the CRO on packaging, pricing, and tracking the studio funnel quantitatively. Public Release & Launch Execution. Drive Beamable’s product through its launch milestones: early design partners, public release, and strategic partnerships. Define and own the go/no-go criteria for each milestone, ensuring the product ships when it’s ready to win. Studio Partnership & Customer Discovery. Spend meaningful time every week with studios, design partners, and game developers — running discovery calls, demos, onboarding sessions, and roadmap reviews. Join sales calls and paid pilots with the CRO and turn each design partner into a reference case. AI Integration & Product Intelligence. Define the guardrails, data policies, and feedback loops that make Beamable’s AI capabilities safe, effective, and trustworthy for game teams. Integrate with best-in-class tools studios already use and shape the intelligent systems that differentiate the platform. Metrics Ownership & Product Function Build-Out. Define success metrics across the studio lifecycle — time to value, pilot conversion, retention, usage, and revenue per studio — and do your own analysis in SQL. Establish the product processes Beamable runs on: discovery, specs, prioritization, and launch reviews. Key Competencies Platform Product Strategy. Proven ability to set and execute product vision for a developer-facing platform, owning the strategy across multiple capability areas simultaneously — not just a feature set. Customer-Facing Product Leadership. Equally credible with studio heads, producers, and engineers. Comfortable running a demo, leading a discovery call, supporting a sale, and representing the product at industry events including GDC and Gamescom. Gaming Live-Ops Domain Expertise. Deep understanding of what a studio’s growth or live-ops team does day-to-day — events, offers, economies, segmentation, player support, and player data — and what slows them down. AI/ML Product Judgment. Experience shipping AI or ML-driven features to production. Knows where AI adds genuine value, where it needs guardrails, and how to define data policies that serve both studio needs and platform integrity. Data Fluency & Metrics Ownership. Can build dashboards, write SQL, and live with retention, churn, and revenue metrics over time. Runs experiments before big bets rather than after. 0-to-1 Startup Product Leadership. Comfortable being the only PM in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment. Has built product processes from scratch and can hold the strategy and the execution at the same time. Technical Depth. Conversant in data warehouses, APIs, SDKs, and system design. Can earn the respect of engineers and studio technical leads without needing a dedicated translator. Experience Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Design, or a related field; equivalent experience considered. 10+ years in product management, including experience as a product lead or head of product owning a product line’s strategy — not just a feature set. Proven experience in gaming live-ops — either running live games or building tools for teams that do: events, offers, economies, segmentation, player support, or player data. Experience at an early-stage or high-growth startup as a solo or founding PM, with demonstrated comfort operating in ambiguity with shifting priorities. At least one AI or ML-driven feature shipped to production and used by real customers. Demonstrated data fluency: SQL, product analytics tools, and a track record of living with business metrics over time to drive decisions. Experience with customer engagement platforms (Braze, CleverTap), game backends (PlayFab, Nakama, Unity Gaming Services), or data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery) preferred. Experience taking a product from early access to public launch preferred. Total Starting Compensation including Base + Bonus + Equity: $212,625 + Bonus + Equity Location: Remote - CA, NV, or NY Travel Requirement: Less than 10% Why Beamable Comprehensive Benefits. 100% coverage for medical, dental, and vision for you and your dependents. 401K matching, equity incentives, pre-tax benefit options, and more. Wellness Support. Meditation and mental health resources, physical fitness coaching and classes, family planning assistance, virtual therapy sessions, and more. Time Off. Competitive PTO and company holidays. Beamable embraces diversity and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As part of our commitment to diversifying our workforce, we do not discriminate on the basis of age, race, sex, gender, gender identity, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, marital status, citizenship, veteran status, or disability status, and we operate in compliance with applicable fair chance ordinances. #GC-Remote #GC-1 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/firy-head-of-product-beamable

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: United States URL: https://www.celebrationspeechgroup.com Benefits: Flexible schedule Opportunity for advancement School Staffing Coordinator / Consultant Independent Contractor (1099) | Commission-Based Opportunity Celebrations Speech Group Inc. is a pediatric therapy and education organization providing services to children and school communities throughout California. Our School Staffing Division partners with school districts to connect students with qualified special education and related-service professionals. We are seeking an experienced School Staffing Coordinator / Consultant to independently develop school district staffing opportunities and support successful placements. This opportunity is best suited for an established recruiting, staffing, education, or business development professional who already understands school district operations and can independently manage relationships and placement activity from initial outreach through successful assignment launch. What You'll Do As an independent School Staffing Consultant, services may include: • Identify and develop staffing opportunities with public, charter, and other school partners. • Establish and maintain professional relationships with school district administrators, special education departments, and other decision-makers. • Develop prospective school partnerships and support the process of securing staffing agreements. • Recruit qualified professionals for school-based opportunities, including speech-language pathologists, SLPAs, occupational therapists, physical therapists, special education professionals, and other related-service providers. • Source, screen, and present qualified candidates for available school assignments. • Coordinate placement information between candidates, school partners, and CSG. • Partner with CSG Human Resources to facilitate credentialing and onboarding requirements for selected candidates. • Monitor placement progress and communicate issues that may affect a successful assignment launch. • Maintain appropriate records regarding active opportunities, candidate activity, placements, and school partnerships. • Support continued communication with school partners and placed professionals as reasonably necessary for successful staffing relationships. Compensation This is an independent contractor opportunity with commission-based compensation . Compensation is tied to successful school staffing placements and qualifying active assignments. There is no guaranteed salary, hourly wage, minimum number of placements, or minimum level of compensation. The specific commission structure, payment milestones, eligibility requirements, and payment terms will be provided in writing as part of the independent contractor agreement before services begin. Earning potential will vary based on successful placement activity, contract value, and continuation of qualifying assignments. What We're Looking For Required: • Prior experience working within a school district is required. Applicants without direct school district experience will not be considered. • Strong understanding of how school districts identify and fill staffing needs. • Demonstrated ability to develop professional relationships and independently move opportunities forward. • Strong communication, organization, and follow-through. • Ability to independently manage recruiting and business development activity. • Ability to maintain confidential candidate, district, and business information. Strongly Preferred: • Experience in special education, related services, school staffing, or educational recruiting. • Existing professional relationships within California school districts or educational organizations. • Experience recruiting licensed or credentialed clinicians and educators. • Familiarity with school-based credentialing, compliance, and onboarding requirements. • Experience with district contracts, staffing agreements, proposals, or similar business development activities. Independent Contractor Relationship This opportunity is structured for an independent professional providing services to Celebrations Speech Group as a 1099 contractor and is not an employee position. The contractor will maintain discretion over the manner and means of providing contracted services, subject to agreed-upon deliverables, placement requirements, contractual obligations, and applicable legal and confidentiality requirements. The contractor may provide similar services to other businesses and is responsible for maintaining their own business operations, equipment, expenses, taxes, and applicable registrations or licenses. No minimum number of hours, school contracts, candidates, placements, or assignments is guaranteed. Ideal Fit You may be a strong fit if you: • Already understand school district operations, staffing processes, and special education environments, with direct prior experience working within a school district. • Are comfortable with both relationship development and recruiting. • Enjoy building partnerships and turning staffing needs into successful placements. • Are highly organized and responsive without needing day-to-day supervision. • Have an established professional network or know how to independently develop one. • Want compensation tied directly to successful results rather than a traditional hourly schedule. If you have experience building school partnerships and placing qualified professionals into educational settings, we would love to hear from you! This is a remote position. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/celebrations-speech-group-inc-school-staffing-coordinator

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Manila, Metro Manila, Philippines URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/dcaVtKQqXr9FwBNppNCBH9/jobs-at-d2b Position: Business Development and Client Engagement Manager Salary: Php 80,000 to Php 100,000/month Working Hours & Conditions: AU Working Hours and Holidays Employment: Full Time - Independent Contractor ABOUT THE COMPANY: The company is dedicated to transforming lives through high-quality, person-centred care. Operating across Western Australia, we deliver trusted Supported Independent Living (SIL), community participation, and specialised support services designed to empower participants and foster long-term independence. Our culture is rooted in genuine empathy, rigorous service standards, and collaborative community partnerships. ROLE OVERVIEW: We are seeking an ambitious, results-driven Business Development and Client Engagement Manager to spearhead our market expansion and drive participant intake across Perth and the wider Western Australian region. Reporting directly to leadership and collaborating closely with the Operations Manager, you will operate as an "A+ Hunter"—proactively identifying referral opportunities, cultivating strategic relationships across the disability and healthcare ecosystems, and managing the end-to-end conversion cycle. This is an autonomous, high-impact field sales role where your commercial acumen, networking capability, and relentless follow-through will directly translate into sustainable service growth and full SIL occupancy. RESPONSIBILITIES: Strategic Outreach & Referral Generation Conduct outbound prospecting to identify and secure referral streams across Perth and Western Australia. Build and nurture strong professional relationships with Support Coordinators, Psychosocial Recovery Coaches, hospital discharge teams, allied health professionals, mental health networks, and justice-transition services. Coordinate and attend targeted field visits and partner meetings to pitch service offerings and establish sustainable intake pipelines. Lead Management & Conversion Respond rapidly to participant enquiries (acknowledgement within 2 business hours) and drive structured lead qualification. Organise and facilitate participant intake meetings, service suitability assessments, and accommodation inspections. Collaborate closely with the Operations Manager to verify service capacity, staffing logistics, and participant matching before finalising agreements. Draft accurate service proposals, quotations, and service agreements, driving follow-ups to achieve prompt execution. SIL Vacancy Management & Service Expansion Actively market and promote available Supported Independent Living (SIL) vacancies across relevant networks. Coordinate property viewings, engage with families and decision-makers, and support safe, appropriate participant compatibility matching. Pinpoint emerging service demands in regional and metropolitan catchments to advise on future property and service expansions. Pipeline Governance & Reporting Maintain daily, end-to-end data integrity within the CRM—logging contacts, meeting outcomes, lead stages, and next actions. Deliver weekly pipeline updates, conversion analysis, and field-activity schedules every Monday by 10:00 AM. Produce monthly performance reviews evaluating channel effectiveness, onboarding numbers, SIL occupancy, and revenue growth. We serve more than 22,000 logistics companies across 193 countries, 23 of the 25 largest global freight forwarders worldwide. With the acquisition of e2open, we have expanded our network to encompass over 500,000 connected enterprises across manufacturing, logistics, channels and distribution. With the vision to be the operating system for global trade and logistics, we are creating a multi-sided marketplace connecting carriers, logistics providers, importers, exporters and shippers. Job Description A Pivotal Moment — Why Join E2open Now In August 2025 WiseTech Global, developer of the world's leading logistics execution software CargoWise, completed its strategic acquisition of e2open. This acquisition represents one of the most significant strategic moves in global supply chain technology in recent years, and it creates an extraordinary moment to join this business. WiseTech's CargoWise platform has historically focused on logistics service providers such as freight forwarders, carriers, and customs brokers. The e2open acquisition brings a deep, complementary product suite and customer base on the other side of the supply chain: the buyers, importers, exporters, shippers, manufacturers and brand owners who generate the freight in the first place. Together, the two businesses create something that has never existed before: a truly end-to-end, multi-sided global trade and logistics marketplace connecting demand, planning, supply, channel, transportation and execution in one ecosystem, all underpinned by AI and data at scale. The Opportunity We are seeking an experienced and driven Area Sales Director to join our growing US sales organization. Each Area Sales Director owns a portfolio of approximately 20-30 enterprise accounts within our CPG business unit. This role sits at the intersection of sales and professional services, with our most successful team members acting as strategic consultants and trusted advisors to our clients to help drive wider adoption of our existing product suite. This role covers the full spectrum of client engagement, from identifying opportunities and closing deals to staying involved throughout implementation to ensure successful delivery. What You'll Do Build and grow a portfolio of enterprise accounts, driving cross-sell, upsell and new logo revenue. Develop trusted, senior-level relationships across your accounts through engaging stakeholders beyond the primary sponsor and maintaining a regular meeting cadence. Act as a strategic advisor, helping clients understand the full value of e2open's platform and keeping satisfaction high. Create and maintain detailed account plans and close plans at the opportunity level. Partner with Solutions Consulting, Legal, Professional Services and other internal teams to progress and close deals. Accurately maintain Salesforce CRM and report on pipeline, activities and performance metrics. Represent e2open at industry events to stay current on market trends and generate new business opportunities. Salary: $100,000-$150,000 Base + Uncapped Commission Qualifications What You'll Bring 8–10+ years in supply chain and logistics, whether in consulting, operations, solution architecture, or enterprise B2B SaaS sales (exposure to S&OP, demand planning or inventory optimization in a CPG environment is highly preferred). Experience selling supply chain, logistics, ERP or adjacent enterprise software. Proven ability to close and manage complex, multi-stakeholder deals across long sales cycles. Confident presenting to C-suite and VP-level executives, with strong written and verbal communication skills. Consultative, value-based selling approach with genuine curiosity about customer challenges. Ability to articulate technical solutions clearly in business terms. Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts and opportunities concurrently. Proficiency in Salesforce or equivalent CRM; strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office. Additional Information When you join WiseTech, you’re joining a team of passionate problem solvers who are committed to changing the world of logistics, one innovation at a time. At the heart of WiseTech’s success lies our exceptional team of people, whose diverse talents and unwavering dedication drive the company forward. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Germany Munich Als Head of Lead Generation verantwortest du den Aufbau, die Performance und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Leadgenerierung. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf Cold Calling. Du bringst fundierte praktische Erfahrung aus der telefonischen Kaltakquise mit, weißt, wie erfolgreiche Outbound-Prozesse funktionieren, und kannst dieses Wissen an ein Team weitergeben. Du bist sowohl operativ als auch strategisch tätig: Du führst und trainierst unsere Cold Caller, optimierst Prozesse und erschließt bei Bedarf weitere Kanäle zur Leadgenerierung. Dabei bist du technisch affin, prozessverliebt und nutzt gerne technische Lösungen und KI-Tools, um unsere Leadgenerierung smarter und effizienter zu gestalten. Tools wie Zapier, Claude Code, Enrichment Tools wie Lusha und Co sollten dir bekannt sein! Aufgaben Operatives Cold Calling: Du kontaktierst potenzielle B2B-Kunden telefonisch, qualifizierst Leads und vereinbarst Termine für unser Sales-Team Teamführung und Training: Du führst unser Cold-Calling-Team, schulst neue Mitarbeitende und coachst das Team, um die Gesprächsqualität und Performance kontinuierlich zu verbessern Strategische Leadgenerierung: Du entwickelst unsere Leadgen-Strategie weiter, definierst Ziele und optimierst bestehende Prozesse. Weitere Outbound-Kanäle: Du steuerst und entwickelst zusätzliche Kanäle wie LinkedIn-Outreach, Cold Mailing und Paid Ads Performance-Management: Du analysierst KPIs, identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale und sorgst für die Erreichung individueller und gemeinsamer Ziele Prozessoptimierung: Du entwickelst Leitfäden, Standards und Best Practices für eine effiziente und skalierbare Leadgenerierung und nutzt Technologie, KI und Automatisierung, um unsere Prozesse kontinuierlich zu optimieren Qualifikation Was du dafür mitbringen musst: Mindestens 1 Jahr praktische Cold-Calling-Erfahrung Erfahrung in der B2B-Neukundengewinnung Erfahrung in der Führung und im Training von Vertriebsteams Du bist technisch affin, prozessverliebt und bringst Erfahrung mit KI-Tools mit und hast Lust, diese gezielt im Vertrieb einzusetzen Idealerweise Erfahrung mit weiteren Outbound-Kanälen Strategisches Denken und eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität Benefits Betriebliche Weiterbildung Flexible Arbeitszeiten 100 % Remote - Arbeite von überall! items.description: About us Handspring has set out to rebuild the pediatric behavioral health system from the ground up. We are a team of diverse, mission-driven, and passionate individuals dedicated to making quality mental healthcare accessible to all young people. We’re seeking a fully-remote Psychiatric-Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP) with child and adolescent psychiatry experience, licensed in New York, to provide care as an independent contractor (1099). This role is for an experienced NP who practices without physician supervision, with consultation from a Handspring psychiatrist available as needed. What you’ll do Work an average base schedule of 8-10 hours a week, including psychiatry evaluations, assessments, and follow ups, as well as consultation administrative tasks Clinical hours can be between 4:00pm-8:30pm est, Monday-Thursday, 4:00pm-6:00pm, Friday EST Please note that your caseload will gradually ramp up over time Provide evidence-based telehealth psychiatric care to children and young adults, ages 8-28 years old Optional participation in ongoing professional development programming Complete clinical notes and documentations in a timely manner in accordance with state and federal regulations Consult with a Handspring psychiatrist as needed on complex cases and medication questions Communicate with the Handspring team as well as your patient’s pediatricians, school counselors, and other members of their family, as needed What sets us apart We’re committed to providing our clients with care that is effective, accessible, and affordable, while also taking care of our clinical team with reasonable caseloads, clinical training, growth opportunities, a supportive community, and other benefits. This is an independent contractor position with competitive compensation We’re an innovative, growing company that uses technology to (1) streamline day-to-day administrative tasks for our therapists and (2) improve clinical care through our online patient portal, where children and families can access education materials and complete journals and rating scales to track client progress We handle
