In this role, you will act as a key member of a commercial‑focused legal team, shaping and implementing legal strategies that support business objectives across marketing, contracting and general commercial…
items.description: Axiom, the leading provider of on‑demand legal talent globally, is seeking a senior legal counsel for an initial three‑month engagement providing parental leave cover. In this role, you will act as a key member of a commercial‑focused legal team, shaping and implementing legal strategies that support business objectives across marketing, contracting and general commercial matters. You proactively assess and manage legal risk, offering clear guidance to stakeholders and collaborating with colleagues to resolve complex issues, ensuring the organisation maintains strong governance, ethical standards and compliance across multiple jurisdictions. Responsibilities: Provide strategic legal advice across a complex multinational environment, ensuring legal guidance supports commercial objectives. Assess and manage legal risk by delivering clear, pragmatic advice and supporting leaders in high‑impact decision‑making. Advise on commercial, contracting and dispute matters using strong analytical and problem‑solving capability. Uphold governance, compliance and ethical standards while maintaining high levels of integrity and professional credibility. Communicate effectively with senior stakeholders through clear written and verbal advice and strong interpersonal engagement. Exercise sound judgment in ambiguity by applying business acumen and legal expertise to deliver confident, timely decisions. Requirements: Provide specialised legal advice across intellectual property, consumer law and general commercial matters during an initial three‑month engagement, drawing on substantial in‑house or top‑tier firm experience. Draft and negotiate complex procurement contracts and manage related disputes, including litigation strategy and resolution. Ensure compliance with Australian legal requirements while applying insight into neighbouring jurisdictions such as New Zealand. Maintain the highest standards of integrity and deliver clear, credible legal guidance to stakeholders in a fast‑moving commercial environment. Why Rejoin Axiom? Flexibility: Choose assignments that fit your lifestyle and career goals. Professional Growth: Continue to develop your expertise through diverse projects. Community: Reconnect with a network of forward-thinking legal professionals. Impact: Contribute to impactful work with leading global organizations. Compensation, Benefits & Location: This role offers a highly competitive compensation and benefits package in the alternative legal services marketplace, that includes health benefits, pension and more. Axiomites also get access to professional development resources and learning and development programs. Axiomites predominately work remotely, with the exception that some clients require on-site presence. Axiom is the global leader in high-calibre, on-demand legal talent. Covering North America, the UK, Europe, and APAC, we enable legal departments to drive efficiency and growth and meet the demands of today’s business landscape with best in breed alterative legal services. Axiom is a leader in diversity, inclusion, and social engagement. Diversity is core to our values and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to be named a best place to work for LGBTQ+ Equality, earning top marks in the 2021 Corporate Equality Index for the second consecutive year. Axiom’s legal department is Mansfield certified and is committed to considering at least 50% diverse candidates for leadership roles and outside counsel representation. Learn more about working at Axiom . Equal Opportunity Employer: Axiom ensures equal employment opportunity in recruitment and employment, without discrimination or harassment on the basis of race, color, nationality, national or ethnic origin, religious creed or belief, political opinion, sex, gender reassignment, pregnancy or maternity, age, disability, alienage or citizenship status, marital (or civil or other partnership recognized by law) status, genetic predisposition or carrier status, sexual orientation, military service, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Axiom prohibits and will not tolerate any such discrimination or harassment. We understand that many legal professionals have chosen to adopt the consultancy model, and we are happy to discuss this option with you. We offer both consultants and employees the opportunity to work with our enviable client roster. Contact us in complete confidence to find out more about opportunities to work with Axiom as an employee or consultant. Accommodation for Individuals with Disabilities: Upon request and consistent with applicable laws, Axiom will provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities who require an accommodation to participate in each stage of the recruitment process. To request an accommodation to complete the application form, please contact us at benefits@axiomlaw.com and include “Applicant Accommodation” in the subject line. Axiom respects your privacy. For an explanation of the kind of information we collect about you and how it is used, our full privacy notice is available at https://www.axiomlaw.com/privacy-notice . Employment with Axiom may be contingent upon successful completion of a background check, providing proof of identity, and possessing the necessary legal authorization to work. By submitting an application, you acknowledge that all information contained therein, and provided at any part of the application process, is correct and accurate to the best of your knowledge. #LI-SC1

items.title: 🌍 Finance Research Expert, Remote- Contract
items.summary: Role Title: Finance Research Expert Role Type: Contract Location: Remote Required Skills:• Equity Research • FP&A • Corporate Finance • Accounting or Audit • Investor Relations • Credit Analysis Opportunity Snapshot:• Time per task: around 4 to 8 hours • Location: Remote, worldwide • You’ll need: Hands-on experience reading US SEC filings and familiarity with US GAAP • Your tasks: Write finance research questions with a verified, sourced answer, and check each one against what AI models answer Scope of Work:• You will work on questions about real US public companies.
items.description: Role Title: Finance Research Expert Role Type: Contract Location: Remote Required Skills: Equity Research FP&A Corporate Finance Accounting or Audit Investor Relations Credit Analysis Opportunity Snapshot: Time per task: around 4 to 8 hours Location: Remote, worldwide You’ll need: Hands-on experience reading US SEC filings and familiarity with US GAAP Your tasks: Write finance research questions with a verified, sourced answer, and check each one against what AI models answer Scope of Work: You will work on questions about real US public companies. Each question points to information that sits in long filings or IR materials, or that requires comparing several of them to find the right answer. Write questions that require finding a specific figure in a 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, proxy statement, earnings release or investor presentation. Write questions where two documents show different numbers and the answer depends on knowing which one is correct (for example, original vs. restated figures, or adjusted vs. reported). Pay attention to period and document version: the right fiscal year, the right filing, the latest amended version. Test each question against current AI models and keep only the ones they answer incorrectly. Rewrite questions when the wording allows more than one valid answer. What we’re looking for: Hands-on work with US filings in one of these backgrounds: Equity research or investment analysis (sell-side or buy-side) covering US companies. Investment banking or corporate development. (M&A, equity capital markets), with experience in deal filings, prospectuses, ownership history and subsidiary structures. Credit or restructuring analysis, with experience in credit agreements, bond terms and bankruptcy filings. SEC reporting or audit. (Big 4 audit, corporate reporting), with experience in restatements, footnotes and how figures change across filings. Corporate law or due diligence. (Securities law, KYC, investigations), with experience tracing entities, executives and related parties across records. You should also be comfortable reading long filings, including footnotes and tables, and have clear written English. How the selection process works: Apply with your resume and a short profile. Complete the finance interview. It is a short conversation about your experience with US filings and financial reporting. You don’t need to prepare or write anything. Finishing it is what moves your application forward. Review. We check your experience against what the project needs. Onboarding and first task. If selected, you get the guidelines and start with an initial task, which is reviewed before you continue. Originally posted on Himalayas

Participate in code reviews and learn from feedback. Assist with API integration and basic back-end tasks. Debug and fix front-end issues. Solid understanding of React fundamentals (components, hooks, router v7, state management validation React 19). Proficiency in TypeScript and modern JavaScript (ES6+). Familiarity with version control (Git) and containerized development. Basic knowledge of Vite build tool and development workflow. Willingness to learn Symfony framework and its components. Ability to maintain the highest level of confidentiality. Exceptional written and oral communications skills in (American) English. Bona-fide setup as an independent contractor. Benefits: Fully flexible schedule, discretionary yearly performance bonus (up to 25% of base yearly compensation). items.description: Product Headquarters: Egypt URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/jzo8hYoyQi6MffQtCgXykk/jobs-at-workmotion Senior Product Manager, Enterprise Location: Remote (Egypt only) Contract type: 1-year renewable contract Salary: €38,000 gross annual salary (fixed + bonus) Not Your Typical Workplace Great talent doesn't stop at borders, and neither do the companies we work with. At WorkMotion, we're building the future of work: helping ambitious companies hire, onboard and manage the best people anywhere in the world through smart, flexible workforce solutions. Remote-first, fast-paced, people-driven and globally connected, we empower businesses to build teams beyond borders. And we're looking for people who want to shape that future with us. More Than a Role We don't just need a Senior Product Manager. We need a builder, a strategic thinker and a product leader who knows how to turn complex enterprise challenges into simple, scalable product experiences. As our Senior Product Manager, Enterprise, you'll own the product strategy and roadmap for our Enterprise segment, shaping solutions that serve large, international businesses with sophisticated needs. From EOR and Direct Hiring to Contractor solutions, you'll make sure our products are ready to support enterprise customers as they grow across borders. This is a role for someone who thrives at the intersection of customer needs, technology and business impact. You'll take ownership from discovery to launch and beyond, transforming customer insights into meaningful product improvements. You'll also explore how AI can unlock smarter workflows, reduce operational complexity and create real value for our customers. You won't be working in a silo. You'll collaborate closely with Engineering, Design, Sales, Customer Success, Operations, leadership, enterprise clients and integration partners. Your mission? Bring everyone together around a clear product vision and deliver experiences that are high-quality, customer-centric, data-driven and built to scale. Where Responsibility Meets Real Opportunity: Own the Enterprise Vision: Define and drive the product strategy and roadmap across EOR, Direct Hiring and Contractor solutions, ensuring alignment with company objectives and OKRs. Build for Scale: Take features from their first version to enterprise-grade solutions, supporting large, multi-country customers with complex approval flows, permissions, reporting and integration requirements. Put AI to Work: Identify, develop and launch AI-powered capabilities that automate manual processes, reduce operational costs and give enterprise customers a competitive edge. Prototype, Test, Improve: Turn ideas into tangible experiences quickly. Build clickable prototypes, validate concepts with customers and iterate before committing engineering resources. Bring Stakeholders Together: Navigate conversations with enterprise executives, internal leadership, Sales and Customer Success. Set clear priorities, manage expectations and know when to say no. Make Data-Driven Decisions: Define success metrics, monitor product adoption and business impact, and continuously improve based on customer feedback and performance data. What It Takes to Make an Impact Here... Your Product Experience: 5+ years of Product Management experience in B2B SaaS, including at least 2 years owning products for enterprise or upmarket customers. Enterprise Product Expertise: A proven track record of scaling products and features for large customers, including complex permissions, workflows, integrations (APIs, HRIS/ERP) and security requirements. AI & LLM Experience: Hands-on experience leveraging AI and LLMs in product development, from identifying valuable use cases to launching solutions and measuring their impact. Prototyping Mindset: Strong prototyping skills and the confidence to build and test concepts yourself using Figma and AI-powered prototyping tools. Stakeholder Management: Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. You can influence without authority, align senior executives and navigate competing priorities without losing sight of the bigger picture. English Communication: Fluent English, both written and spoken, with the ability to communicate complex product concepts clearly and confidently. Bonus Points If You Bring: Experience in HR tech, payroll, EOR or global employment solutions. Familiarity with enterprise sales cycles, RFPs and security reviews, including SOC 2, ISO 27001 and GDPR. Experience building integrations with HRIS/ERP platforms such as Workday, SAP SuccessFactors or Personio. German or another additional language, helping you connect with a wider range of international customers and stakeholders. Not Your Typical Team: You'll join a talented and ambitious Product team based in Egypt, Germany and beyond. We're a fully distributed group of product minds who believe that great collaboration isn't about sharing an office, but about sharing ideas, challenging assumptions and building something meaningful together. We don't just work together; we create, challenge and grow together. We value curiosity, ownership and open communication. Everyone has a voice, ideas are welcomed, and cross-functional collaboration is at the heart of how we operate. If you're looking for an environment where you can influence product strategy, challenge the status quo and turn bold ideas into real business impact, you'll feel right at home. The Perks of Being Here... Global, remote, and thriving: We're a global team of talented individuals spread across 26 countries. Our WorkFlex program lets you work from anywhere, anytime, subject to applicable location requirements. Your well-being is our priority: We know mental health matters, which is why we offer a dedicated Well-Being Day, a full day off just to recharge and relax. Get fit and stay active: Whether it's yoga, weightlifting or a quick jog, work out on your terms with discounted subsidised gym memberships. Learn, grow, and develop: We believe in continuous growth. Our Training & Development Allowance gives you the opportunity to keep expanding your skills and knowledge. Stay connected: Take part in exciting annual team meetups and connect with colleagues across our global team. Diversity is our superpower: We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. Benefits vary depending on location due to local laws and regulations. At WorkMotion, we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. If you need any accommodations during the recruitment process, just let our Recruitment Team know at Jobs@WorkMotion.com. We're here to support you every step of the way! To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/workmotion-senior-product-manager

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Texas URL: https://kyro.ai Sales Development Representative (SDR) Location: Remote, non-US based, working US Central Time business hours Experience: 1-3 years in a B2B SDR/BDR role Employment type: Full-time Reports to: Product Manager - Growth ABOUT KYRO AI When a major storm knocks out power, utilities race to mobilize crews and get the lights back on. Kyro AI builds the software behind that effort: workforce and contractor management for electric utilities, storm restoration contractors, and aggregators. We are headquartered in Plano, Texas, and were spun off from Think Power Solutions, so we pair long-standing utility expertise with the pace and ownership of a product company. https://kyro.ai/ WHY JOIN KYRO - Work that matters: our platform helps communities get power back after storms and keeps a critical, regulated industry compliant. - A growing product suite: StormShield for storm restoration, Kyro Capital for contractor invoice factoring, KORY (our AI copilot), and contractor onboarding and verification. - Credibility from day one: you sell with the backing of real utility relationships and domain know-how. - Close to leadership: direct access to the CEO and product team, and what you hear from customers shapes the roadmap. - Room to grow: a clear path from SDR to Account Executive. - Flexibility: fully remote team. THE ROLE As an SDR, you are the first conversation most utilities and contractors have with Kyro. You will work two segments with very different buying motions: Utilities (enterprise): You will talk to storm response, emergency management, contractor management, supply chain, and procurement leaders. Cycles are long, involve multiple stakeholders, and are often tied to RFIs/RFPs. A win is a qualified discovery meeting or demo handed to the account team. Contractors (SMB to mid-market): You will talk to owners, operations managers, and storm coordinators at line, vegetation, and restoration contractors. Cycles are shorter, phone-first, and owner-led. A win is a demo held and the contractor signed up and onboarded. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Prospect outbound: research target utilities and contractors, build account lists, and reach decision-makers by phone, email, and LinkedIn. - Own the follow-up: run multi-touch cadences, chase no-shows and stalled conversations, and make sure every lead has a dated next step. - Respond to inbound leads the same business day and qualify them before they go cold. - Qualify with rigor: confirm need, timeline, decision process, budget, and compliance requirements before booking. - Book and confirm demos, send reminders, and hand off with clear notes. - Drive conversions: stay with contractors after the demo until they sign up and start onboarding; keep utility opportunities moving to the next stage. - Keep the CRM clean: log every activity, stage change, and next step. - Feed the product team: share objections, competitor mentions, and feature requests from the field. HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED Success is measured on demos held and the conversions that follow. Activity counts are leading indicators, not the goal. KPIs: demos booked, demos held, demo-to-opportunity rate, conversions (contractors signed up and onboarded; utility opportunities advanced to proposal or pilot), pipeline sourced, speed to lead, follow-up coverage (share of open leads with a dated next step), and outreach activity. Targets are set separately for each segment; utility credit weighs meetings and pipeline more than closed conversions. WHAT YOU BRING - 1-3 years as an SDR or BDR in B2B sales, ideally SaaS, with a record of hitting or beating meeting and demo quotas - Disciplined follow-up across phone, email, and LinkedIn without being reminded - Confident cold calling, including with field-oriented buyers who rarely live in their inbox - Clear, concise written communication - Hands-on experience with a CRM and a sales engagement tool (HubSpot, Apollo, Outreach, Salesloft, or similar) - Comfort with metrics: you track your own funnel and know where deals stall - Ability to learn a technical, regulated domain quickly - Self-directed and organized in a fully remote setting - Native English speaker, available during US Central Time business hours NICE TO HAVE - Experience selling into utilities, energy, construction, field services, or regulated industries - Familiarity with storm restoration, line work, vegetation management, or contractor ecosystems - Exposure to both enterprise (long-cycle) and SMB or self-serve sales motions - Experience selling workforce management, compliance, or fintech products - Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience COMPENSATION AND PROBATION - Competitive market base plus uncapped commission. Base is paid bi-weekly and commission quarterly. - Accelerators: 1.5x at 101-125% of quota, 2.0x above 125%. - The first six months are probationary, with performance reviews at 3 and 6 months against ramped KPI targets (demos held, conversions, follow-up coverage). - If targets are not met, Kyro may extend the probationary period or end employment. - - Employment remains at-will during and after probation. WHAT WE OFFER - Competitive base and variable pay - A fully remote role - A clear path to Account Executive for SDRs who consistently hit target - Direct exposure to product and leadership at a company shaping how utilities run storm response To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/kyro-ai-sales-development-representative

items.description: We Breathe Life Into Data At Komodo Health, our mission is to reduce the global burden of disease. And we believe that smarter use of data is essential to this mission. That’s why we built the Healthcare Map — the industry’s largest, most complete, precise view of the U.S. healthcare system — by combining de-identified, real-world patient data with innovative algorithms and decades of clinical experience. The Healthcare Map serves as our foundation for a powerful suite of software applications, helping us answer healthcare’s most complex questions for our partners. Across the healthcare ecosystem, we’re helping our clients unlock critical insights to track detailed patient behaviors and treatment patterns, identify gaps in care, address unmet patient needs, and reduce the global burden of disease. As we pursue these goals, it remains essential to us that we stay grounded in our values: be awesome, seek growth, deliver “wow,” and enjoy the ride. At Komodo, you will be joining a team of ambitious, supportive Dragons with diverse backgrounds but a shared passion to deliver on our mission to reduce the burden of disease — and enjoy the journey along the way. The Opportunity at Komodo Health This role performs configuration tasks to meet Komodo Health customer requirements, working closely with the Solution Architect. They are the experts on configuration and collaborate with the project team and our clients. This person is part of the Configuration Team, working closely with the Solution Architects to design and build out the configuration creatively and efficiently to meet the requirements. They will also work closely with the Business Analyst during the test writing phase and with the testing team during test execution to provide expertise and guidance. Looking back on your first 12 months at Komodo Health, you will have… Lead and/or contribute to the configuration of solutions for multiple customer projects, both small and large, delivering on customer requirements and enhancing customer satisfaction. Participate in client-facing design reviews, working sessions, and training to demo and illustrate solutions. Collaborate with other project team members to gain efficiencies and help implement best practices for project delivery and knowledge transfer. You will accomplish these outcomes through the following responsibilities… Design and configure appropriate solutions given the clients’ requirements (40%) Document and implement configuration changes and data-mapping requirements (10%) Review requirements and ensure solutions meet the requirements (10%) Configure client-facing solutions, including structural and functional applications, troubleshooting errors, manipulating data, and transformations, all the while utilizing new and familiar tools throughout (20%) Support and participate in client presentations and design reviews to build strong working relationships with clients and analyze feedback to ensure alignment (10%) Participate in client training and other implementation initiatives as a part of overall project deliverables (10%) What you bring to Komodo Health: Experience configuring and solutioning on the Salesforce platforms with exposure to end-to-end project implementation lifecycles Ability to effectively design scalable solutions to meet client business needs and perform system configuration Experience working in a collaborative project team environment Experience authoring requirements, writing design documentation, and other related project and system documentation Demonstrated analytical skills, problem-solving, and experience across the complete lifecycle of complex enterprise projects, from pre-sales, requirements gathering, design and build, review and refine, validation, and deploy Goal-oriented with a superior work ethic while being self-motivated Ability to leverage AI tools (Gemini, ChatGPT, Cursor, etc.) to enhance personal productivity, streamline workflows, or improve decision-making Additional skills and experience we’d prioritize (nice to have)… Salesforce Certification and consulting experience a plus Life Sciences experience, particularly Pharmaceutical is a plus Experience interacting with, managing, or building with AI agentic workflows Komodo’s AI Standard At Komodo, we’re not just witnessing the AI revolution – we’re leading it. This is a pivotal moment in time, where being first to market with AI transforms industries and sets the bar. We’ve already established industry leadership in leveraging AI to revolutionize healthcare, and we expect every team member to contribute. AI here isn’t optional; it’s foundational. We expect you to integrate AI into your daily work – from summarizing documents to automating workflows and uncovering insights. This isn’t just about efficiency; it’s about making every moment more meaningful, building on trust in AI, and driving our collective success. Join us in shaping the future of healthcare intelligence. Where You’ll Work Komodo Health has a hybrid work model with hubs in San Francisco, New York City, and Chicago. Roles vary — some can be performed from anywhere in the country, others are scoped to a specific region, and some are based near one of our hubs. For hub-based Dragons, we’re building intentional in-office rhythms alongside the flexibility that’s core to how we work. Whatever your setup, expectations will always be clear before you join. Equal Opportunity Statement Komodo Health provides equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type with regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read and understand Komodo Health’s Privacy Notice for Employees and Contractors. This notice explains how we collect, use, and retain applicant data.

items.description: Please note that we are unable to consider applications from candidates based in France, Italy, or Germany for this role. Money is moving onto the internet, and the shift has a name: Open Money. This is money that is open, portable, agentic, and owned by you. MetaMask spent the last ten years building it; with 100M+ downloads, users in ~190 countries, and trillions in cumulative transaction volume, it's the most trusted self-custodial financial platform on the internet. Now we're building the operating system for your money: one place to hold, move, grow, and use anything you own. Join a remote-first, global team rebuilding how money works: a problem that touches everyone, every day. About the role This role runs the internal posture engine — the risk register, critical control monitoring, evidence, audit operations and GRC tooling. It keeps risk state current so the Lead and the Risk Committee decide from accurate data in the Risk Dashboard and reporting. Drata is the register of record. Named owners close gaps; this role keeps the register, evidence and audit operations current. Responsibilities Planning Operate the risk register from the Security Programme threat model: populate, track treatment, record acceptance decisions, follow up owners, and run the exceptions register. Keep the ISMS and security policy library current as part of audit readiness. Draft security standards when commissioned by the Lead. Run Drata as the control and evidence system — Statement of Applicability, framework crosswalk and automation. Execution Run critical control monitoring: health check-ins, drift flags and Drata automation. Route drift to the SOC. Maintain the evidence file for Lead assessments and independent internal audit. Feed threat-assessment findings into the register and confidence ratings. Track which required assessments are current. Lead audit coordination and preparation: ISO 27001 and SOC 2 logistics, ISMS readiness, team prep, management-review pack, and customer due-diligence questionnaires. Coordinate the control register for external testing (red team, tabletop, pentest). Run security awareness and weekly alerts. Tracking and evaluating performance Track residual risk, exceptions and gap-closure against appetite. Exceptions expire and are reported; the underlying requirement stays in force. Report register state and evidence health so the Lead and Risk Committee work from one view. Achieving overall defined performance Be accountable for a current, defensible posture engine — register, evidence and audit operations. Ensure Drata collects evidence continuously, with automated evidence where coverage exists. Qualifications Hands-on experience running a risk register, control library and audit cycle (ISO 27001 and/or SOC 2). Comfortable with GRC platforms (Drata or equivalent) and turning monitoring into evidence. Proven ability to coordinate audits and customer questionnaires with named control owners. Precise written work; register and Statement of Applicability quality matters. Strong stakeholder management with control owners and auditors. CISA, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Auditor, or equivalent professional certification. Don't meet all the requirements? Don't sweat it. We’re passionate about building a diverse team of humans and as such, if you think you've got what it takes for our chaotic-but-fun, remote-friendly, start-up environment—apply anyway, detailing your relevant transferable skills in your cover letter. While we have a pretty good idea of what we need, we're ready for you to challenge our thinking on who needs to be in this role. The salary range listed for this role applies to US-based candidates only. Compensation for candidates based outside the US (including Canada, EMEA, and LATAM) will be determined based on location, experience, and skills during the interview process, and may differ from the listed US range. US pay range (not including bonus, equity or other benefits) $150,000—$206,000 USD In the rapidly evolving Web3 space, we believe that everyone is a builder. This expansive paradigm requires a range of backgrounds, talents, skills, and experiences to influence and shape the future. At MetaMask, this diversity fuels our ability to shift control and redefine the realm of possibility. We are committed to ensuring that our technology empowers people and communities through decentralized technologies. We welcome the range of perspectives and differences and celebrate them. We're excited to see how your unique skills as a builder can contribute to our vision, drive innovation, and help us shape a more inclusive Web3. MetaMask is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. MetaMask is aware of fraudulent recruitment practices and we encourage all applicants to review our best practices to protect yourself, which can be found on our page. MetaMask may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruitment process, such as reviewing applications, screening resumes, or conducting initial candidate assessments. These tools are designed to assist our recruiting team and improve efficiency — they do not replace human judgment. A human recruiter or hiring manager reviews every candidate, and all final hiring decisions are made by people, not AI. It is a requirement of employment in this position that applicants may be required to submit to background and identity verification checks, including but not limited to employment, education, criminal record checks, and other such checks as determined necessary by the company.

Pipeline & Forecasting: Manage your team’s opportunity pipeline, forecast new business and expansion outcomes weekly, and own the accuracy of your team’s number. Identify risk early and coach reps on deal strategy. Commercial Accountability: Be accountable for your team’s achievement of new business acquisition, expansion, adoption, and consumption targets. Partner closely with Sales, Customer Experience, Professional Services, and regional leadership on account planning and execution. Deal Coaching & Technical Strategy: Accompany Customer Engineers on critical customer calls, QBRs, discovery sessions, and PoC reviews. Provide real-time coaching on architecture, commercial positioning, and executive communication. Operational Excellence: Ensure the team operates efficiently within established GTM processes (forecasting, opportunity management, account planning, QBR cadence). Use dashboards and operational reviews to spot trends, unblock friction, and drive consistency. AI & Productivity Enablement: Champion the adoption of AI agents, LLMs, and automation tools across the team. Identify opportunities to reduce toil, improve response quality, and scale technical advisory impact. Cross-Functional Leadership: Serve as the voice of your team and your territory in leadership meetings. Partner with Product, Engineering, Support, Marketing, and Enablement to surface field feedback and advocate for customer and team needs. Culture & Values: Model Cloudflare’s values and build an inclusive, high-performance team culture rooted in curiosity, ownership, and continuous improvement. Minimum Qualifications Experience: 5+ Years of proven experience leading quota carrying customer-facing technical teams in a SaaS, cloud, or infrastructure environment. Track record of hiring, developing, and retaining technical talent. Prior quota-carrying Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Sales Engineering, or related technical field experience is strongly preferred. Architectural Mindset: Ability to white-board, design, and articulate complex enterprise network and security architectures clearly enough to guide coaching and deal review. Consultative & Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives. Revenue Acumen: Demonstrated success owning and forecasting a revenue number, preferably in an enterprise B2B SaaS or infrastructure environment. Deep understanding of enterprise sales cycles, SaaS metrics, ACV, renewal, and expansion motions. Leadership & Coaching: Excellent people management skills with the ability to coach technical sellers through complex deals, difficult conversations, and career growth. Comfortable giving direct, actionable feedback. Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication with the ability to influence executives, peers, and cross-functional teams. Capable of representing the team in executive QBRs and regional business reviews. AI Proficiency: Familiarity with AI-augmented workflows, LLMs, and automation approaches that improve team productivity. Willing to lead by example in adopting AI tools. Technical Fluency: We do not expect managers to be hands-on engineers across every domain. Qualified candidates will demonstrate fluency in at least two or three of the following technical areas, with the ability to follow architecture discussions and coach reps: Internet fundamentals: Strong foundational understanding of how the Internet works, including DNS, HTTP(S), TCP/IP, and SSL/TLS. Security: Foundational knowledge of security concepts such as WAF, Bot Management, Zero Trust, SASE, and threat mitigation. Performance: Foundational knowledge of performance concepts such as caching, latency, content delivery, and traffic steering. Platform / Cloud Fluency: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms, edge services, APIs, automation, or developer tooling. Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The “Good-to-Haves”) Cloudflare Ecosystem Expertise: Experience with Cloudflare’s product portfolio or familiarity with CDN, security edge, Zero Trust, developer platform, or AI workloads. Scaled Management Experience: Experience managing managers or teams distributed across regions and time zones. GTM Process Design: Track record of improving operational cadence, enablement, and forecasting discipline within a fast-growing technical sales organization. Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of compliance frameworks such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, SOC 2, GDPR, or FedRAMP. Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth. Education: Undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field. Compensation For France based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €123,000 - €193,000. This role is labelled CSP Position 3-2 and has a coefficient of 210, as per the SYNTEC Collective Bargaining Agreement. Equity This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan. What Makes Cloudflare Special? We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. Project Galileo : Since 2014, we’ve equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers–at no cost. Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we’ve provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states. 1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers. Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you! Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process. This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license. The Associate Director / Director of Product Management, Signatera…
items.description: Position Summary: Natera is a global leader in cell-free DNA testing, focused on changing the management of disease in reproductive health, oncology, and organ transplantation. Signatera is a personalized, tumor-informed test for molecular residual disease (MRD) assessment and surveillance monitoring in patients previously diagnosed with cancer. The Associate Director / Director of Product Management, Signatera Heme will own the product strategy and roadmap for Signatera in hematologic malignancies, starting with multiple myeloma and lymphomas. This person will work in a highly matrixed environment with the Foresight BU, R&D, Lab Operations, Software Engineering, Medical Affairs, Marketing, Business Development, and Regulatory. The role combines product management, market entry as a laboratory developed test (LDT), evidence generation, analytics, and clinical trial product support, including trials run under IUO and IVD pathways. Primary Responsibilities: Develop and execute the Signatera product roadmap for hematologic malignancies, beginning with multiple myeloma and lymphomas (for example, DLBCL, follicular, mantle cell, and Hodgkin lymphoma) and extending to additional heme indications. Lead market entry planning for Signatera in heme as a laboratory developed test (LDT), including clinical validation requirements, CLIA and state requirements, market access/reimbursement and payer considerations, and launch readiness with Lab Operations, Regulatory, Medical, commercial and Marketing. Define product requirements for blood-based malignancies with R&D, Lab Operations, and Software Engineering, including assay, sample type, workflow, and reporting needs. Lead product support for clinical trials using Signatera in heme, including IUO use in studies with pharma and academic partners, and the path toward IVD and regulated use. Partner with Regulatory, Clinical, and Business Development on trial start-up, study requirements, and pharma and companion diagnostic opportunities. Build product performance metrics and dashboards. Analyze test volume, adoption, ordering patterns, turnaround time, and retention. Use the results to prioritize improvements. Partner with Medical Affairs and Clinical on evidence generation strategy and execution. Areas of collaboration include identifying clinical gaps, designing studies, working with investigators and trial partners, and planning publications and congress presentations. Guide product development for Signatera Genome in heme, including whole genome sequencing technology, phased variants, and structural variants. Work with R&D and Bioinformatics to define how these features improve tumor tracking and MRD sensitivity in heme malignancies. Conduct Voice of Customer interviews, market research, and competitive and market intelligence in hematologic oncology. Engage with key opinion leaders, advisory boards, and congresses (for example, ASH, EHA, and ASCO). Gather insights to guide product decisions. Work with Marketing on product positioning, launch plans, pricing, and key collateral. Build business cases and financial models to support product initiatives. Present strategy, progress, and data-driven recommendations to executive leadership. Performs other duties as assigned. Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, statistics, engineering, or a related field. Advanced degree (MS, PhD, or MBA) preferred. 5+ years (7+ preferred) of experience in product management, product marketing, or market analytics at a diagnostics, biotech, or pharmaceutical company. Hematologic oncology experience is strongly preferred, especially multiple myeloma and lymphoma. Working knowledge of oncology molecular testing, next-generation sequencing (NGS), and biomarkers, including NGS bioinformatic workflows (e.g., variant calling, filtering, and interpretation) and genomic data analysis. MRD experience preferred. Experience with data analysis. SQL, Snowflake, or similar tools preferred. Familiarity with a high complexity molecular laboratory, including cfDNA or plasma workflows, is a plus. In depth knowledge of whole genome sequencing and variant types, including structural variants, single nucleotide variants, and phased variants, is preferred. Experience with clinical trials. Experience in IUO and IVD regulated environments is required. Experience bringing a molecular test to market as an LDT, including clinical validation and laboratory requirements. Experience designing or supporting clinical evidence generation, such as clinical validation studies, retrospective studies, or prospective trials. Prior KOL engagement and external customer facing experience preferred. 30-40% travel for advisory boards, congresses, and customer meetings. Knowledge, Skill, and Abilities: Technical Understanding of MRD in multiple myeloma and lymphomas, including how blood-based MRD testing fits withing current bone marrow and imaging-based MRD assessment paradigms. Understanding of how somatic variants are detected in whole genome sequencing and how they support MRD tracking in heme tumors. Understanding of LDT market entry requirements and the evidence needed for clinical adoption and payer coverage. Ability to translate customer and clinical needs into clear product requirements. Strong analytical skills. Able to build metrics, interpret data, and present findings. Basic financial modeling skills. Proficiency with MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint. Behavioral Ability to lead without authority and influence cross-functional teams. Strong written and oral communication skills and ability to function effectively in a highly matrixed cross functional environment. Ability to explain complex topics simply (biomarkers, multiple indications, regulatory pathways). Strong customer focus, including building relationships with thought leaders. Strong organization and time management. Able to manage several projects at once and meet tight deadlines. Flexibility between fast development and quality standards. Clear written and verbal communication with senior leadership. PHYSICAL DEMANDS & WORK ENVIRONMENT Duties are typically performed in a [remote home office / hybrid office] setting. This position requires the ability to use a computer keyboard, communicate over the telephone and computer, and read printed material. Duties may require working outside normal working hours (evenings and weekends) at times. While the position may be based anywhere in the United States, availability during Pacific time hours is required and site based presence in San Carlos CA, Boulder CO, or Austin TX is preferred. Travel required for this position: 30-40% (advisory boards, congresses, customer meetings). The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations. Remote USA $180,300—$230,900 USD OUR OPPORTUNITY Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives. The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management. WHAT WE OFFER Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program! For more information, visit www.natera.com . Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws. If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents. Link: https://www.natera.com/notice-of-data-collection-california-residents/ Please be advised that Natera will reach out to candidates with a @ natera.com email domain ONLY. Email communications from all other domain names are not from Natera or its employees and are fraudulent. Natera does not request interviews via text messages and does not ask for personal information until a candidate has engaged with the company and has spoken to a recruiter and the hiring team. Natera takes cyber crimes seriously, and will collaborate with law enforcement authorities to prosecute any related cyber crimes. For more information: - BBB announcement on job scams - FBI Cyber Crime resource page

items.description: About League League is one of the fastest-growing technology companies in Canada and the leading healthcare experience platform. Getting healthcare is often the easy part — finishing it is where things fall apart: people book the appointment and skip the follow-up, fill the prescription and stop taking it, get the referral and never make the call. That gap costs health plans and health systems money, and it costs people their health. League closes that gap — identifying what each person needs to do next, clearing what’s in their way, and getting it done, for the 70 million+ people whose care already runs through our platform. Health plans and health systems trust us to do this at scale. Organizations like Manulife, SCAN, Geisinger, and Medibank on the payer side, and Baptist and Shoppers Drug Mart on the provider side. Position Summary: This is a builder role, not a maintainer role — equal parts strategy and execution. You're the most senior growth marketing hire on a team that's re-building its demand generation engine. You'll have the budget, a team, and direct access to leadership to do it. You'll be marketing into two of the most sought-after B2B buyer groups in health tech: payers with long procurement cycles and multiple clinical/financial stakeholders, and providers balancing patient experience against margin pressure. If you want to prove you can build and run demand gen at enterprise scale, in a category where the sales cycle actually tests your craft, this is that proving ground. You're inheriting a full, well-funded MarTech stack — Salesforce, Pardot, Bizible, Demandbase, and Qualified — and the website itself, but the job isn't to just run any of it as-is. We want someone who rebuilds how that stack operates to be agentic-first: designing AI agents that pull signal to plan campaigns, launch and sequence them across channels, and continuously test and optimize without manual hand-offs between tools. What You'll Do: Own and optimize our tech stack and website Own pipeline generation across paid search, paid social (LinkedIn), SEO, content, lifecycle/email, and account-based marketing Continuously test messaging, creative, and campaign structure — and bring examples of non-boilerplate campaigns that actually moved pipeline Own reporting: define KPIs and dashboards, and keep pipeline numbers trusted by Sales Own the AI-Native Workflow strategy and AI Engine Optimization (AEO): as buyers increasingly use LLMs to research vendors, you have ideas on how to build League's presence in those results Strategically partner cross-functionally with Sales, Product Marketing and Revenue Operations Security-Related Responsibilities Compliance with Information Security Policies Ensure access management is performed in compliance with the employee's role and responsibilities Responsibility and accountability for executing League's policies and procedures within the department/ team Notification of HR, Legal, Compliance & Security of any incidents, breaches or policy violations What You'll Bring: 7+ years in B2B demand generation or growth marketing, with real ownership of pipeline outcomes — not just campaign support Enterprise background: you've marketed to large, complex organizations with long sales cycles and multiple stakeholders; payer or provider experience is a strong plus Hands-on across the full stack: paid search, paid social (LinkedIn), SEO, content, and account-based marketing Fluent in the pipeline metrics that matter here — MQL/SQL/SQO conversion, pipeline contribution, cost per opportunity — not just CAC/LTV/ROAS Real experience building AI agents or automations, not just prompting a chatbot — bonus if you already gravitate toward MCP-first, Salesforce-native tools Strategic and hands-on: you're equally excited to set the plan and execute it Bonus: experience with ABM platforms like Demandbase or 6sense Bonus: experience in HealthTech, FinTech, InsurTech, or other large enterprise-focused products CANADA APPLICANTS ONLY: The Canada-specific compensation range below for this full-time position is exclusive of bonus, equity and benefits. This range reflects the minimum and maximum target for base salaries for the position across all Canadian locations. The salary range is intentional to account for the performance and career progressions a Leaguer will experience in the role throughout their time at League. Where in the band you may land is determined by job-related skills/experience. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range specific to your skills and experience during the hiring process. Compensation range for Canada applicants only $145,000—$170,000 CAD AI Fluency & Ways of Working At League, we are an AI-native organization . We expect all employees regardless of role or level to thoughtfully leverage AI to improve the quality, speed, and impact of their work. What this means in practice: Use AI tools as part of your daily workflow to enhance productivity, problem-solving, and decision-making (e.g., drafting, analysis, coding, research, or process automation) Apply judgment and accountability when using AI by reviewing outputs for accuracy, bias, and quality before use Continuously learn and adapt as new AI tools and capabilities emerge, incorporating them into your ways of working Identify opportunities to improve how work gets done from personal productivity to team-level workflows by leveraging AI effectively Operate with strong data responsibility and security awareness , especially when working with sensitive or regulated information How this scales by level: Individual Contributors: Use AI to improve personal productivity and quality of output Senior ICs / Managers: Integrate AI into team workflows and improve processes Leaders: Drive AI adoption at the organizational level and shape how work is done across teams What we look for: Demonstrated experience using AI tools in a practical, responsible way Curiosity and openness to experimenting with new technologies Ability to balance efficiency with quality and sound judgment Our employees come from different backgrounds, and we celebrate those differences. We are looking for the best candidates for our open roles, but do not expect applicants to meet every qualification in order to be considered. If you are excited about what you could accomplish at League and believe you can add value to our team, we would love to hear from you. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you are an individual in need of assistance at any time during our recruitment process, please contact us at recruitinginfo@league.com . Our Application Process: Applying to a role you love can be exhausting, and understanding the next steps can feel vague and uncertain. You have done the hard part of submitting your application; let's do ours by sharing potential next steps You should receive a confirmation email after submitting your application. A recruiter (not a computer) reviews all applications at League. If we see alignment with League's needs, a recruiter will reach out to learn more about your goals. The recruiter will also share the team-specific interview process depending on the roles you are exploring. The final step is an offer, which we hope you will accept! Prior to joining us, we conduct reference and background checks. Additional checks could be required for US Candidates, depending on the role you are exploring. Here are some additional resources to learn more about League: Learn about our platform, leadership team and partners Highmark Health, Google Cloud, League: new digital front door to seamless care Former Providence President and Workday EVP of Corporate Strategy join League Board of Directors League raises $95 million USD in Series C to build world’s leading healthcare CX platform Forbes x League: The Platformization Of Healthcare Is Here Fast Company x League: If we want better innovations in healthtech, we need more competition Work Location: We have a mix of office-centric roles based in our vibrant Toronto office, and remote-eligible roles based anywhere in Canada or US. Each job posting will indicate where the role will be based. Regardless of the role’s posted location, all Toronto-area Leaguers (living within 65 km of our downtown HQ) collaborate in-office Monday through Thursday. Depending on your distance to the office, you’ll enjoy 10 or 20 Flexible Remote Days each quarter for focus and deep-work time. We are committed to fostering a meaningful work environment and connections for all Leaguers regardless of location. Recognize and Avoid Employment scams. Practice safe job searching. Scammers are getting craftier and leveraging fake job postings to get personal information. Know the warning signs and protect yourself from scammers. Learn more here . Use of AI Notice We are committed to ensuring fairness and transparency throughout our hiring process. League may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools to assist in the screening of applicants for this position. Please check out our stance on using AI in recruitment here . Privacy Policy Review our Privacy Policy for information on how League is protecting personal data.

items.description: Location Details: At GoDaddy the future of work looks different for each team. Some teams work in the office full-time; others have a hybrid arrangement (they work remotely some days and in the office some days) and some work entirely remotely.​ Remote: This is a remote position, so you’ll be working remotely from your home. You may occasionally visit a GoDaddy office to meet with your team for events or meetings. About The Team.... Global Compute runs Optimised Hosting, GoDaddy's global platform for all customer hosting products. Squad R is the engineering team responsible for operating, scaling, and continuously improving the OpenStack-based clouds that power that platform. We treat reliability as an engineering problem: we automate toil away, we plan capacity ahead of demand, and we instrument everything so that we understand our systems before they surprise us. As an SRE III on the team, you'll be a senior technical contributor who others lean on for the hard problems. What you'll get to do... Operate and scale GoDaddy's cloud infrastructure, including our OpenStack-based hosting platform. You'll troubleshoot and improve services spanning compute, networking, and storage in large-scale production environments. Drive the OpenStack migration. Help move customer hosting workloads onto the platform safely — designing and executing migration tooling, validation, and rollback strategies that protect customer experience. Work within a large-scale global hosting environment supporting thousands of servers and customer workloads across multiple regions. Eliminate toil through automation. Build and maintain automation in Python and Puppet to replace manual operational work. Treat repeated manual effort as a bug to be fixed. Strengthen observability. Improve monitoring, alerting, and dashboards so that signal reaches the right engineer at the right time, and so that we can reason about system behavior from data. Participate in on-call and incident response. Take a fair share of the on-call rotation, lead incident response when you're the responder, and drive the blameless post-incident process that turns failures into permanent fixes. Raise the engineering bar. Review peers' code and designs, document systems and runbooks clearly, and mentor SRE engineers. Contribute to the AI/MCP initiative. Help bring AI-assisted workflows and internal MCP tooling into our operations so internal customers can resolve problems and incidents faster. Participate in a shared on-call rotation (after onboarding) and help lead incident response activities when needed. Your experience should include... 5+ years in SRE, infrastructure, platform, or systems engineering roles operating production systems at scale. Strong Linux systems fundamentals — networking, storage, processes, performance troubleshooting. Proficiency in Python for automation and tooling (writing maintainable, tested code — not just scripts). Hands-on experience operating distributed systems and diagnosing issues across service boundaries. Experience with infrastructure-as-code and configuration management (Puppet, Ansible, or equivalent). Comfort owning production reliability: on-call experience, incident response, and a track record of reducing toil through automation. Clear written and verbal communication — able to document systems, write post-incident reviews, and collaborate across a distributed, remote team. You might also have... Experience operating OpenStack (Nova, Neutron, Ceph) or comparable cloud infrastructure platforms Experience with Docker, Kolla, or containerised infrastructure Experience supporting large distributed systems at scale Experience operating Ceph or other software-defined storage at scale. Exposure to OpenStack migration or cloud-migration programs. Interest in applying AI/LLM tooling to operational workflows. We encourage you to apply even if your experience or skillset doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement. We value a wide range of backgrounds and transferable skills, and we are excited to support learning and growth. We've got your back... We offer a range of total rewards that may include paid time off, retirement savings (e.g., 401k, pension schemes), bonus/incentive eligibility, equity grants, participation in our employee stock purchase plan, competitive health benefits, and other family-friendly benefits including parental leave. GoDaddy’s benefits vary based on individual role and location and can be reviewed in more detail during the interview process. About us... GoDaddy is empowering everyday entrepreneurs around the world by providing the help and tools to succeed online, making opportunity more inclusive for all. GoDaddy is the place people come to name their idea, build a professional website, attract customers, sell their products and services, and manage their work. Our mission is to give our customers the tools, insights, and people to transform their ideas and personal initiative into success. To learn more about the company, visit About Us . At GoDaddy, we know diverse teams build better products—period. Our people and culture reflect and celebrate that sense of diversity and inclusion in ideas, experiences and perspectives. But we also know that’s not enough to build true equity and belonging in our communities. That’s why we prioritize integrating diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging principles into the core of how we work every day—focusing not only on our employee experience, but also our customer experience and operations. It’s the best way to serve our mission of empowering entrepreneurs everywhere, and making opportunity more inclusive for all. To read more about these commitments, as well as our representation and pay equity data, check out our Diversity and Pay Parity annual report which can be found on our Diversity Careers page . We also embrace our diverse culture and offer a range of Employee Resource Groups ( Culture ). Have a side hustle? No problem. We love entrepreneurs! Most importantly, come as you are and make your own way. GoDaddy is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. GoDaddy will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with local and federal requirements. Refer to our full EEO policy. Our recruiting team is available to assist you in completing your application. If they could be helpful, please reach out to myrecruiter@godaddy.com. GoDaddy doesn’t accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies.

items.description: About the Role We're looking for a Director of EMEA Sales Operations to be the dedicated GTM Operations partner for our EMEA region. This role sits at the centre of EMEA's go-to-market motion, spanning New Logo, Growth, and Commercial/hybrid motions across a fast-growing, multi-country region. You will partner directly with the VP of EMEA and the region's Account Executives, Business Development Reps, and Solutions Architects to deliver the insights, enablement, and processes that power territory design, quota allocation, pipeline and forecasting hygiene, and the region's operating cadence. Because EMEA spans many countries and time zones relative to global GTM Operations and Systems teams based in the US, this role requires someone who can operate with real autonomy, exercise judgment on what to escalate versus solve locally, and represent EMEA's specific needs (FSI and financial services-heavy Strategic accounts across UK/Ireland and DACH, multiple hybrid Commercial motions, territory splits across UK/Ireland, DACH, Nordics, and Southern Europe) back into Temporal's global GTM Operations function. We're building a GTM Operations function that is AI-native from the ground up. We expect this leader to bring demonstrated experience using AI tools to accelerate analysis, surface insights, and scale operational work—not as a future aspiration, but as a core part of how they work today. Responsibilities Serve as the dedicated Sales Operations partner for EMEA, supporting New Logo, Growth, and Commercial/hybrid motions across the region, and knowing when to solve locally versus escalate to global GTM Operations or Systems. Partner with the VP of EMEA and regional sales leadership to deliver actionable insights on net-new pipeline generation, account penetration, and territory design. Own pipeline visibility and forecasting hygiene across all EMEA motions, including large complex enterprise deals, consumption workload ramps, and Commercial/self-serve pipeline. Conduct white-space and TAM analysis to identify high-propensity targets across EMEA's markets, with particular attention to the region's concentration of financial services, banking, and fintech accounts. Identify process gaps across the region's hunting, growth, and hybrid motions, and partner with GTM Systems to scope and implement automation—including AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual effort and increase regional coverage. Analyse regional sales performance (win/loss, deal velocity, conversion, quota attainment) across segments, and translate findings into clear recommendations for the VP of EMEA and regional leaders; leverage AI tools to accelerate analysis and surface patterns at scale. Build and maintain Salesforce and Omni reporting and dashboards tailored to EMEA, supporting Strategic, Growth, and Commercial views (including CQA/Tiered account, SSU, and workload metrics specific to the region). Support the region's full operating cadence: forecasting calls, QBRs, pipeline reviews, and account planning sessions, often prepping leadership with regional metrics ahead of cross-timezone reviews. Drive annual and in-year planning for EMEA: capacity plans, territory carving and re-carving (including account transitions as reps' territories evolve), and quota allocation across New Logo, Growth, and Commercial. Evaluate new market entry and partner with regional GTM leadership on market expansion priorities, including coverage models and impacts to org design. Qualifications Experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or Field Operations supporting a B2B enterprise or strategic sales organization in technology or software. Proven track record supporting multiple sales motions at once: net-new logo hunting, growth/expansion within existing accounts, and self-serve or hybrid AE-assisted motions. Demonstrated AI-native working style: hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini, Notion AI, or purpose-built GTM AI tools) to accelerate analysis, automate repeatable ops tasks, generate insights from large datasets, and improve the speed and quality of decision-making. We are not looking for theoretical familiarity—we want to see how AI is embedded in how you work today. Deep experience across EMEA markets and fluency in the cultural and commercial similarities and differences across these markets. Hands-on experience with building equitable territories, account scoring, quota allocation, and capacity modelling across a multi-country region. Strong Salesforce expertise, including building scalable reports and dashboards across multiple sales motions and segments. Highly analytical, with the ability to turn data into clear, actionable insights for regional sales leadership; comfortable pairing SQL, BI tools, and AI assistants to move faster and go deeper. Strong cross-functional partner who can work effectively with regional sales and SA leadership, global GTM Operations, GTM Systems, and Marketing. Comfortable presenting insights and recommendations to senior regional and global leadership. Able to operate both strategically and tactically depending on business needs. Bonus: experience operating in a consumption-based business, with a strong understanding of how usage impacts forecasting, pipeline, and quota planning for newly acquired and expanding accounts. Bonus: experience evaluating or deploying AI-powered GTM tools (e.g., AI forecasting, account scoring, pipeline intelligence, or conversation intelligence platforms) and driving adoption across a regional sales team. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We embrace and celebrate differences and diversity. items.description: Who We Are Hi, we're DuckDuckGo , the online protection company and remote-first team of 400+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on Mac , Windows , iOS , and Android , our search engine , and the DuckDuckGo subscription . We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai , which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place. Partnerships Team The Partnerships team sources, negotiates, and manages external relationships behind DuckDuckGo's products, from AI model and cloud infrastructure providers to distribution, content, and monetization partners. Alongside that work, the team also handles a steady stream of vendor deals for the software, tooling, and service contracts that keeps the company running. Our Need We are seeking a well-established, independent Procurement Advisor Practice to advise the partnerships team in DuckDuckGo's vendor selection, procurement and negotiations. Our procurement efforts cover a broad set of vendors including collaboration tools, AI services, SaaS, analytics and data tools, developer tooling, and professional services. We are seeking a procurement advisory practice that will provide our team with counsel on needs scoping, vendor identification, vendor conversations, price negotiations strategies and benchmarks, and guidance on proposed terms. DuckDuckGo remains responsible for our internal processes and approvals, and for signing vendor contracts. Advisory Practice Profile 10+ years advisory practice in procurement, strategic sourcing, or vendor management, with a focus on software and SaaS. Your practice has provided direction on hundreds of contracts and has deep enough experience to provide clients with guidance on where the leverage usually is. Your practice has a well-established approach to commercial and contractual details -- including deep experience in providing guidance on order forms, MSAs, and DPAs terms, a time-tested methodology for vendor comparison, and proven track record of working across a client organization including with legal, security, finance, product, engineering. Your practice has sufficient capacity to advise many small deals in parallel, each with a different internal owner. Your practice has deep experience in providing deal advisory across a broad set of vendors: collaboration, recruiting, analytics, developer tooling, data and research subscriptions, professional services. Your practice has a proven track record of building trust quickly with client teams, providing clear client communications, and working asynchronously across multiple time zones in North America and Europe. Your practice care s about privacy and has experience in navigating data handling and security issues with clients and vendors. Your practice is an established business: an operating entity or registered sole proprietorship with other current clients, its own professional liability insurance, and client references available on request. Your practice is located in the US. Engagement Details We expect the scope of work to cover an estimated 3 to 5 deals per month (estimated approximately 15-20 hours per week) compensated by a fixed rate, with pricing for additional volume set out in the statement of work, starting with an initial six-month term with the option to extend. This is a business-to-business services engagement, not employment. Your practice will deliver advisory services remotely on its own schedule with working sessions scheduled by mutual agreement. Your practice will use its own equipment, tools, and methods. DuckDuckGo will provide the deal information and access to internal deal owners needed for each engagement, and limited system access where a specific deal requires it. As an independent consultant, your practice is responsible for its own taxes, insurance, and business expenses, and invoices DuckDuckGo monthly under the statement of work. How to Submit a Proposal Please send a short proposal to bdhiring@duckduckgo.com with the subject line of “Procurement Advisory Services“ covering your practice's background and structure, representative clients and references, your proposed approach and the personnel who would perform the work, and your fee proposal for the scope above. Nondiscrimination Policy DuckDuckGo evaluates proposals without discrimination on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws. We want to ensure that our selection process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the proposal process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to bdhiring@duckduckgo.com to let us know the nature of your request. Please note that: Your practice will be subject to DuckDuckGo's standard vendor due diligence, including privacy and security review, and must confirm that any personnel assigned to the engagement have passed a background check conducted by your practice. By submitting a proposal, you confirm that all information submitted is accurate and complete. You further acknowledge that providing false or fraudulent information is cause for rejection of the proposal or immediate termination of the engagement. DISCLOSURE STATEMENT: USE OF AI IN VENDOR SELECTION As part of our commitment to enhancing our vendor evaluation process, we use artificial intelligence (“AI”) tools to help review and summarize proposals, flag potentially fraudulent submissions, and compare proposals against our evaluation criteria. All final selection decisions are made by DuckDuckGo personnel. Information you submit will be handled in accordance with our privacy policies. If you have questions, contact bdhiring@duckduckgo.com . Thank you for your interest in working with DuckDuckGo!
