items.description: Are you an experienced geospatial professional eager to shape the future of AI? We’re developing a geospatial reasoning agent focused on Crisis Response—helping AI systems understand, assess, and predict real-world events where data is uncertain or incomplete. Your expertise will guide model development and evaluation, laying the foundation for future geospatial reasoning and forecasting applications. We’re looking for experts with deep experience in geospatial analysis, crisis response, or related domains such as damage assessment, agriculture, site selection, supply chain optimization, or forecasting. You’ll evaluate AI-generated outputs, identify analytical weaknesses, and design metrics and test cases that advance model understanding and predictive accuracy. On a typical day, you’ll review geospatial scenarios, validate model outputs, define and refine reasoning frameworks, and collaborate with our team to improve data-driven evaluations. Ideal candidates bring professional experience in geospatial analysis, GIS systems, or spatial modeling within industries such as crisis management, logistics, or environmental planning. Proficiency with geospatial tools and libraries (e.g., QGIS, ArcGIS, GDAL, PostGIS) is preferred. Strong reasoning, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate complex spatial relationships clearly are essential. Ready to apply your geospatial expertise to the frontier of AI? Apply today and help design intelligent systems capable of supporting real-time global decision-making. We offer a pay range of $24 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor, you’ll supply a secure computer and high-speed internet connection; company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply. Job title: Geospatial Reasoning Specialist – AI Trainer Employment type: Contract Workplace type: Remote Seniority level: Senior Level Originally posted on Himalayas

This is the number one creative seat in the company, not a slot in a large agency hierarchy. The strategist hired here
items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: New York, New York, United States URL: https://sweetspothvac.com/ About SweetSpot Heating & Cooling SweetSpot is a growing home-services company in the New York metro, and we are building our creative team from zero. This is the number one creative seat in the company, not a slot in a large agency hierarchy. The strategist hired here owns the function, works directly with the owner, and has a real path to leading the team as we scale. About the role We are hiring a creative strategist who will own paid ad creative end to end: research, angles, hooks, scripts, briefing creators and editors, and the learnings that turn winners into the next batch. This is not a "make pretty ads" role and it is not strategy-only. You will direct really strong video editors and UGC creators, and you will use AI (including Claude Code) as your production engine for research, hooks, scripts and variants. We are honest about the level this role is hired at: we are looking for strong raw talent with real direct-response instincts who wants ownership and serious training, and who wants to grow into a top-tier strategist with us. You will get mentorship, a proven creative system, and weekly learnings reviews. In return we expect pace, curiosity, and work you can defend. What you will do Build the research base first: homeowner avatars, desires, objections, competitors, and our own ad account history. No angles before research. Plan concepts in a structured roadmap, each with angle, avatar, desire, mechanism, authority, awareness level, emotion, positioning and urgency. Write hooks and scripts built for the first 3 seconds: one desire, one avatar, one message per ad. Brief UGC creators and editors so clearly they can execute with no follow-up call, and review their work to a finished, launch-ready ad. Run the testing system: from one winning angle, build structured iterations where each variation tests something named. Run the learnings: label every ad (Breakthrough, Spend Winner, KPI Winner, Loser), state why it performed, and turn that into the next round. Hit 20 to 30 finished, launch-ready ads per month at full pace, working with our editors and AI workflows. What we are looking for Direct-response ad experience: you have written ads that ran as paid social (Meta or TikTok) and you can show them. A testing system, not just good taste. You can explain how you turn one winner into 20 variations. Research discipline. Your hooks trace to evidence, not guesses. AI fluency: you already use AI tools in your creative workflow and can show how. Execution: you have briefed creators or managed editors and shipped finished ads. Ownership mindset: you talk about business outcomes, not just outputs delivered, and you close feedback loops: you learn, you apply, you show what changed. Local services or lead generation experience is a plus, not a requirement. Seasonal urgency, emergency calls, proof and trust are the game here. Pay and structure Contract (1099), remote, month-to-month: $4,000 to $8,000 per month, 40 hours per week, based on experience. Performance bonus structure discussed after the trial month, tied to winning ads. Growth path: this seat grows into leading the creative team. One of the paths we model is editor or strategist to team lead as spend scales. Our hiring process (exactly how it works) Short application: portfolio of ads you wrote that actually ran, plus 3 short answers (your testing system on a real winner; one ad you iterated and what it tested; your AI workflow). Interview 1 (30 minutes): screening and craft in one call, run as a working session on your past ads: what did you learn, how did you apply it, what feedback loops did you complete. Paid test: $100 flat, 48 hours, capped at 4 hours of work, paid regardless of outcome. A short research snapshot, hooks, scripts, an iteration plan and an execution plan for a real scenario. Interview 2 (final, with the owner): we walk your test together and you defend your choices. References are checked after this call (we will ask to speak with one past employer). Two interviews total, no more. Paid 30-day trial at your full agreed monthly rate, with daily contact, mentorship and a weekly check-in. Written decision at day 30. We hire off the test and the trial, not the interview. If you are the kind of strategist who would rather prove it than pitch it, apply. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sweetspot-heating-and-cooling-creative-strategist-ai-native-direct-response

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Burlington, MA OR US Remote Looking for an innovative, high-growth, multi-award-winning company in one of the hottest segments of the security market? Look no further than Veracode! Veracode is a global leader in Application Risk Management for the AI era. Powered by trillions of lines of code scans and a proprietary AI-generated remediation engine, the Veracode platform is trusted by organizations worldwide to build and maintain secure software from code creation to cloud deployment. Learn more at www.veracode.com , on the Veracode blog , and on LinkedIn and Twitter . Veracode is seeking a Senior Website Manager to own the strategy, governance, performance, and ongoing evolution of Veracode.com. Reporting to the VP of Product Marketing and working closely with the Creative Director, this role will lead the website roadmap, improve operational excellence, and turn business priorities into high-performing digital experiences that increase traffic, engagement, lead generation, and conversions. You will own the web roadmap, lead the migration from WordPress to Webflow through launch and partner with marketing, creative, demand generation, operations, IT, and agency teams to translate business needs into scalable website experiences. You will oversee site infrastructure, reusable templates, page builds, campaign support, content publishing, and continuous optimization for speed, security, accessibility, SEO, GEO, and user experience. The Senior Website Manager will improve the full digital journey, from organic discovery and campaign landing pages to content engagement, form conversion, personalization, and post-click experiences aligned to priority personas. This role balances strategic ownership with hands-on execution. The Senior Website Manager should be comfortable setting priorities, managing stakeholders, improving governance, and jumping into the details of site updates, QA, analytics, campaign launches, and CMS operations when needed. This is a hands-on role. The manager will build and edit pages in Webflow, troubleshoot tracking and form issues, and review agency work in the code and configuration, not just in screenshots. Key Responsibilities Migration Ownership — Take ownership of Veracode’s in-flight migration from WordPress to Webflow and drive it through launch and post launch stabilization. Align stakeholders, leadership, and agency partners on scope, timelines, deliverables, dependencies, risks, and success criteria. Validate and lead work on content and URL audits, redirect mapping, SEO/GEO/AEO preservation, analytics, integration testing and launch planning. Day-to-Day Site Management — Manage daily website operations, intake, prioritization, page updates, QA, publishing, troubleshooting, and stakeholder requests while maintaining high standards for accuracy, usability, performance, and brand consistency. Data and Analytics — Use GA4, Google Tag Manager, heatmaps, dashboards, and campaign data to monitor traffic, behavior, conversions, attribution, and funnel performance, then translate insights into optimization priorities. Content Governance and Quality Control — Maintain site content standards, taxonomy, metadata, redirects, page ownership, review cycles, archival processes, and content hygiene so the website stays accurate, discoverable, compliant, and easy to maintain. Strategic Roadmap and Vision — Architect and execute web strategies that incorporate AI-enabled personalization, SEO, GEO, campaign performance, content experience, and conversion optimization to drive traffic, engagement, and pipeline impact. Design Strategy & Governance — Lead visual and UX evolution, ensuring designs align with brand identity; manage scalable design systems, wireframes/prototypes (e.g., Figma), and trends like micro-interactions, organic layouts, and performance-driven creativity. Own the translation of Figma designs into Webflow components and templates. Conversion-First UX & AI-Enhanced Personalization — Direct user journeys for high-stakes pages; implement AI-driven adaptive experiences and A/B testing to optimize funnels. Privacy, Consent, Accessibility and Compliance — Partner with legal, security, and marketing operations to manage cookie consent, privacy requirements, data collection standards, accessibility, and compliance needs across website experiences. As a security company, our site is held to a high bar for security hygiene, accessibility and privacy. Performance Optimization — Use Core Web Vitals monitoring, A/B and multivariate testing, heatmaps, and performance insights to balance rich visual experiences with site speed and continuously improve funnel performance. Reporting and Executive Visibility — Establish recurring website performance reporting, dashboards, insights, and recommendations that connect website activity to pipeline, campaign impact, SEO performance, conversion trends, and business priorities. SEO, GEO and Growth Management — Lead technical SEO, GEO, keyword strategy, and content performance to improve organic visibility across traditional and generative search experiences. Technical Oversight — Manage Webflow, WordPress, or similar enterprise CMS environments, and coordinate with IT and development teams on infrastructure, security, bugs, integrations, and new features. Manage WordPress through sunset and Webflow as the long-term platform, including CMS structure, permissions, hosting, and custom code. Website Release Management and QA — Own launch readiness for new pages, templates, campaigns, integrations, and site changes, including requirements intake, testing, stakeholder approvals, rollback planning, documentation, and post-launch monitoring. Cross-Functional Leadership — Partner with marketing, creative, product marketing, demand generation, marketing operations, IT, sales, agencies, and vendors to gather requirements, align priorities, manage dependencies, communicate tradeoffs, and deliver website initiatives on time. Vendor and Agency Partnership — Act as the primary liaison for web development partners and agencies. Scope projects, manage timelines and deliverables, conduct quality reviews, and ensure external teams align with Veracode standards, brand guidelines, accessibility expectations, and strategic objectives. Hold agencies accountable to defined acceptance criteria and evaluate their technical work independently. Marketing Automation Integration — Work with marketing ops to ensure seamless ties with Marketo forms, lead capture, and CRM (Salesforce). This role gathers business, technical, design, campaign, and content requirements to deliver high-performing website experiences. You will administer infrastructure, manage CMS operations, build scalable templates and interactive experiences, publish content, improve governance, and continuously optimize site performance. Required Skills & Qualifications 8–10+ years in web management, digital marketing, or web program management, with strong emphasis on strategy, design oversight, and growth. Experience leading a full CMS migration for a large B2B site (hundreds of pages or more), including redirect mapping, SEO preservation, and tracking validation. Strong experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager, UTM strategies, SEO and GEO tools (SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog), and CRO (A/B testing, heatmaps like Hotjar). Knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, MySQL; frontend literacy (e.g., CSS Grid/Flexbox, animations). Familiarity with website security, ADA/WCAG compliance (accessibility-first design), performance optimization, and 2026 trends like AI personalization and immersive interactivity. Proven project management skills (e.g., Jira, Asana); experience managing agencies, vendors, in-house teams (development/design). Strong analytical mindset; ability to present performance, design, and growth reports to executives. Stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration expertise. Experience with Marketo and Salesforce form/CRM integrations. Webflow Enterprise experience is a plus. Examples of A/B Testing Strategies This Role Might Lead Headline/CTA variations on landing pages to boost conversions (e.g., testing benefit-focused vs. feature-focused copy). Layout changes (e.g., grid vs. organic/asymmetric) or visual elements (e.g., hero images/videos, micro-animations) for engagement/time-on-page. Form optimization (e.g., multi-step vs. single-page) or personalization (e.g., AI-segmented content) for lead capture. Button colors/sizes/text or navigation tweaks to improve click-through and funnel progression. Compensation Transparency: The total compensation package includes an anticipated base salary range of $125,000–$140,000, along with comprehensive benefits. The base salary offered to the selected candidate, including the candidate’s position within the salary range, will be determined based on a variety of factors, including job-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, and other business considerations. The published salary range represents the Company’s good-faith estimate of the compensation range at the time of posting. Employment opportunities are available to all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Fraudulent Recruitment Alert - Be Aware and Stay Informed At Veracode, we prioritize a secure recruitment process. Unfortunately, fake recruitment and job offer scams are on the rise. They aim to deceive candidates through emails and calls to obtain sensitive information. Here’s our recruitment promise to you: Comprehensive Interview Process: We never extend job offers without a comprehensive interview process involving our recruitment team and hiring managers. Offer Communications: Our job offers are not sent solely through email, and we will never ask you to pay for your own hardware. Email Verification: Recruiting emails from Veracode will always originate from an “@veracode.com" email address. This is a strategy role, not a media-buying role. You’ll be a senior strategic partner to enterprise clients and our creative leaders: advising on performance creative, shaping new solutions, and s
items.description: As a Senior Performance Strategist at Superside, you’ll own how the work performs in market: what runs, how it’s tested and how it keeps getting better. This is a strategy role, not a media-buying role. You’ll be a senior strategic partner to enterprise clients and our creative leaders: advising on performance creative, shaping new solutions, and spotting opportunities for ongoing optimisation and account growth. You’ll work alongside our creative strategists, creative teams and product team, using evidence to turn great ideas into results for global brands. What You’ll Do Bring performance data and past results into every brief, so strategy starts from what people actually do. Lead performance-focused projects, finding the opportunity in the data and briefing creative teams. Turn campaign ideas into in-market plans across channels, formats and audiences. Design testing roadmaps and measurement frameworks, and set up tests and tracking. Analyse creative performance to show what’s working, what isn’t and why. Optimise creative in market, scaling what works and moving people through the funnel. Turn results into clear recommendations on what to scale, cut and try next. Advise senior client stakeholders as a trusted strategic partner, presenting results and recommendations with confidence. Identify opportunities to grow accounts, from ongoing optimisation programs to new performance offerings. Incorporate an AI-native mindset across the whole strategic process. Partner with our product team to invent and build new performance creative solutions, workflows and offerings that scale across clients and studios, going beyond applying existing tools. Share learnings and help shape how performance and creative strategy work together. What You’ll Need to Succeed 7+ years in performance or growth strategy at an agency or brand, with a focus on performance creative. Experience independently leading complex performance strategy engagements and influencing senior client stakeholders and creative leaders. A track record of designing and running creative testing programs that improved results. Strong analytical skills across major ad platforms, with a working grasp of attribution and measurement. Full-funnel experience across paid social, acquisition and conversion. The ability to find creative opportunities in data and write briefs creative teams want to run with. A belief that brand and performance work best together. Genuine curiosity about emerging technology and experience experimenting with or building new workflows. Strong presentation and communication skills, with experience working directly with senior clients. Curiosity, collaboration and a commitment to growing your strategic craft. Why Join us? Superside’s vision is to create equal opportunities globally by accelerating the world’s transition to online work. With that in mind, we’re building a fully remote company that attracts people where they are. Remote-first. Customer-led. Remote isn’t just a perk; it’s how we deliver better for customers. We are fully committing to our customers by hiring top talent and collaborating seamlessly across time zones. Global team, local impact. Join a community of 60+ nationalities working across time zones, cultures, and disciplines, all aligned on doing great work for great brands. High performance, low ego. Work in a fast-paced, high-trust environment where feedback is direct, growth is constant, and kindness leads collaboration. Impact meets opportunity. We’re in the sweet spot — big enough to be stable, small enough for you to shape what’s next. Your ideas will matter here. Grow fast. Lead well. You’ll gain mentorship, take on real responsibility, and grow your career while helping us disrupt a global industry. About Superside Superside is the leading AI-powered creative company that quickly and cost-effectively enhances in-house functions. We help over 500 ambitious brands get great creative concepts done at scale. Built to be an extension of in-house teams, we unbottleneck marketing and creative teams so they can move faster and drive more reliable creative performance. Superside is a fully remote company with over 700 team members working across 60+ countries and 13 timezones. Learn more at superside.com Diversity, Equity and Inclusion We’re an equal-opportunity company. All applicants will be considered regardless of ethnicity, appearance, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, veteran or disability status. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

items.description: Why You’ll Never Want to Leave Respect People. Produce Results. For more than 35 years, we’ve built a reputation for both the work we do and how we do it. Respect shows up in how we work together and with our clients. It means trusting people to do their jobs, giving them the space to do it well, and holding each other to a high standard. Because when people are respected, they do better work, work that grows businesses, shapes culture, and builds relationships that last. And just as important, they have the support to build a career and a life worth investing in. Who You’ll Be Collaborating With Every day, you’ll be teaming up with a diverse, enthusiastic, multi-disciplinary team of professionals with a smart sense of humor and a strong desire to grow and develop. We’re looking for an experienced freelance Social Media Community Manager to join our Brand and Connections Strategy team, supporting social programs for a major automotive brand and a leading fuel brand. This is a fast-paced, hands-on role focused on the day-to-day management of social communities across platforms Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Threads, and X. Responsibilities include community moderation, proactive and reactive engagement, crisis alerts and management, content calendar management, publishing, social listening, and identifying opportunities for timely, low-lift content. You’ll step into established social programs and brand voices, working closely with strategy, creative and account teams to keep both brands responsive, relevant and connected to their communities. Beyond managing conversations, you’ll help identify what those conversations can tell us, surfacing shifts in sentiment, recurring audience behaviors, cultural moments and opportunities that can inform content and strategy. The role also includes client-facing responsibilities, including contributing to sentiment reporting, content calendar reviews, and sharing community insights and recommendations. We’re looking for someone who’s energized by culture, curious about audience behavior, and is ready to support our teams and their priorities. Essential Job Functions Community management is one of the most direct ways people experience a brand on social. In this role, you’ll help support how brands listens, responds, and participate in culture in ways that feel timely, useful and true to their established voices. Manage day-to-day community engagement across social platforms (proactive and reactive), fostering positive community experiences and meaningful one-to-one interactions Write and publish platform-native social copy and engagement responses according to brand guidelines Monitor brand sentiment, cultural trends, and relevant conversations across social platforms, contributing to the creation of reactive, low-lift social content (e.g., replies, captions, simple visuals, short-form or mobile-first content) informed by real-time conversation and trends Schedule and publish social content across native channels and social media management tools Identify social listening insights and opportunities to inform monthly content planning Contribute social sentiment analysis and insight to monthly reports Identify and escalate sensitive issues, emerging risks, or customer service concerns according to established brand protocols Bring relevant community learnings to the Social & Digital Strategist to help evolve content and engagement strategies Confidently participate in client-facing meetings by sharing community insights, engagement learnings, and reports Required and preferred hard and soft skills 2+ years of experience managing social media communities for brands, agencies, consumer-facing organizations, or freelancing Experience working in social media management tools to schedule and publish content, manage and reply to inbound messages, and manage creative assets required (experience working in Sprinklr strongly preferred) Experience using tools to monitor trending topics and brand sentiment in social media and formulating plans of action for brand engagement and/or response as appropriate (Sprinklr, Sprout Social, Hootesuite, Crimson Hexagon/Brandwatch, Netbase, Meltwater, native platform analytics, etc.) Strong familiarity and proficiency managing brand accounts across major and emerging Social Media platforms Experience working in high-pace environments and collaborative team settings Relentlessly curious; seeks to understand not just what is happening, but why Culturally aware and proactive, always looking for new ways to engage communities and improve how brands show up in social Strong interest in social media trends, internet culture, and evolving platform behaviors Comfortable collaborating cross-functionally and contributing to client-facing settings Highly organized and able to maintain quality and accuracy across two fast-moving social programs Have an exceptional attention to detail; sweat the small stuff and pride yourself on the pursuit of precision As an Equal Opportunity Employer, at RPA we hire without consideration to race, religion, creed, color, national origin, age, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, disability, or any other classification protected by federal, state, or local law. The semi-monthly salary range for this position is $2,500.00 - $2,916.67, with an annualized equivalent of $60,000 - $70,000.

At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and h
items.description: AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation. At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD. We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual’s age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage & civil partnership, pregnancy & maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, and sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived. _ We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD. _ Role Overview We are looking for a commercially aware Client Operations Specialist (COS) to manage and support UK and European relationships of our existing enterprise clients, whose accounts are primarily based in and managed from the United States. Our clients include globally recognised organisations across sectors such as pharmaceuticals, financial services, legal services, and entertainment. This role requires building and maintaining strong relationships with a range of stakeholders, including internal teams, client contacts, and external vendors and suppliers. From time to time, the role may involve client engagement activities such as attending meetings, meals, or industry events. Working within a small, collaborative team, supporting operational sales processes including vendor registrations, quotation preparation, and order processing. The role requires excellent attention to detail, strong organisational skills, and confidence working with high-value transactions (often involving six-figure sums) whilst being comfortable working within a fast-paced environment. Key Responsibilities Act as a consistent UK-based contact for sales coordination and customer service support. Build and maintain strong relationships with existing clients and key internal stakeholders. Continually develop knowledge of the IT industry, relevant technologies, and market trends. Maintain effective relationships with channel partners, manufacturers, and distribution partners. Collaborate with Pre-Sales and external Sales teams to support revenue generation and deliver high levels of customer satisfaction. Work closely with the Sales Operations team to manage shared workloads, ensure timely turnaround of quotations and configurations, and promote a collaborative team culture. Provide administrative and operational sales support to the global sales team and, where appropriate, directly to customers. Work with manufacturers and distribution partners to configure solutions, obtain pricing, and process product orders. Complete vendor registrations, pricing requests, and related administrative requirements with accuracy. Obtain and maintain relevant product certifications. The company will provide and fund the necessary training programs and examination fees. Share knowledge and provide internal training to colleagues where appropriate. Assist with the preparation and presentation of proposals and tender responses (including RFPs and RFIs) where required. Skills & Experience Essential Excellent attention to detail and accuracy. Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines. Excellent communication, relationship-building, and problem-solving skills. Strong time management and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced sales environment. Ability to work independently when required, including when working from home. Experience working with high-value commercial transactions. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, as well as Salesforce or similar CRM systems. Experience supporting enterprise or blue-chip clients with annual expenditure in excess of £1 million. Desirable Experience using vendor registration and pricing systems such as Cisco, Dell, Juniper, Palo Alto, HPE, & Nutanix. Previous experience managing or supporting large corporate client accounts. Experience working for a medium-to-large IT reseller or channel partner. Strong working knowledge of Salesforce would be highly desirable. Fluency in at least one additional language (written and spoken), to support effective communication with clients and stakeholders across the EMEA region and strengthen the team’s multilingual capabilities. Working Hours The standard working hours for this role are 9.00 am to 6.00 pm, Monday to Friday. This role is hybrid and the expectation would be a minimum of 2 days a week in the office, the company is committed to supporting flexible working arrangements where possible, in line with business needs. Occasional evening or weekend work may be required to support business needs or client activities. Travel The role may require up to 10% travel, which may occasionally include international travel. Additional Information The role holder must be able to carry out the essential functions of the role; reasonable adjustments will be considered to support individuals with disabilities or health conditions in accordance with the Equality Act 2010. Individuals are responsible for working safely and in accordance with company health and safety policies and relevant HSE guidance. The role may require up to 10% travel, which may occasionally include international travel. This job description outlines the general nature and level of responsibilities associated with the role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of duties, and responsibilities may change in line with business requirements. You must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role. £45,000 - £55,000 a year _The compensation range indicated in this posting reflects the On-Target Earnings (“OTE”) for this role, which includes a base salary and any applicable target bonus amount. This OTE range may vary based on the candidate’s relevant experience, qualifications, and geographic location._ Why AHEAD: Through our daily work and internal groups like Moving Women AHEAD and RISE AHEAD, we value and benefit from diversity of people, ideas, experience, and everything in between. We fuel growth by stacking our office with top-notch technologies in a multi-million-dollar lab, by encouraging cross department training and development, sponsoring certifications and credentials for continued learning. Use of AI: We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, assessing responses, or to capture recordings and create transcriptions or summaries during interviews. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please refer to the UK Candidate Privacy Notice / Netherlands Candidate Privacy Notice or contact us at [email protected]. You may opt-out of the review or analysis of your application and resume by AI tools by using the General Application. Please include the role you wish to apply for in the Additional Information field. You may also choose to opt-out of recording and transcription at any time, including after joining an interview. Candidates will not be penalized for choosing to opt-out. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

items.title: Revenue Cycle Manager
items.summary: About Us We are fixing US healthcare by building an AI-native physical care platform, starting with home health. Home health is a $140B industry with less than $10B in EBITDA â 40% of revenue is spent on pure administrative waste. We automate this work with AI, creating a fundamentally different cost structure compared to incumbents. This lets us rapidly take market share by serving the 30% of patients who go untreated today. By reshaping the cost structure of this industry, we unlock its growth. We've built one of the best AI teams in the world (from Character AI, Scale, Palantir, Citadel, Jane Street) and paired them with a team of healthcare veterans to build a new type of healthcare company: one that delivers care at the speed of an AI company. Our physical care platform already operates with 30pp higher gross margins than traditional home health providers. With our AI advantage, we pay nurses more, remove their admin burden, and unlock the scale economics that have been missing from this fragmented industry. If we served this entire $140B market, instead of $10B in EBITDA, we'd drive $60B. We're starting with home health, then expanding to all delivered care. Our mission is "any care, any where" . Fundamentally, our incentives are aligned with America. Every dollar in revenue we make is two dollars taken out of the healthcare system. If we succeed, so does US healthcare. Role overview Weâre seeking a hands-on Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) Manager to lead and support a team of specialists in a home health environment. This manager will stay close to daily operations, monitor team performance, and respond quickly to questions and emerging issues to help the team meet its goals. The role focuses on accounts receivable (AR), helping the team move outstanding claims from follow-up to verified resolution. What Youâll Do Manage and support RCM specialists working across home health revenue cycle workflows. Track attendance and monitor individual and team performance against established KPIs and daily quotas. Review workflow boards throughout the day to spot backlogs, red flags, and specialists at risk of missing their end-of-day quotas. Respond promptly to specialist questions while balancing real-time workflow monitoring and other team needs. Identify process gaps and work with the team to resolve issues affecting daily performance. Apply your home health and Homecare Homebase (HCHB) knowledge to help specialists navigate workflows and resolve operational questions. Accounts receivable and collections Guide specialists and team leads in prioritizing assigned commercial, Medicare, and Medicare Advantage receivables, including aged balances, payer responses, rejections, denials, and upcoming filing or appeal deadlines. Oversee claim follow-up through resolution: verify claim status and payment, investigate collection barriers and underpayments, and guide appropriate corrections, reprocessing, reconsiderations, or appeals under payer-specific requirements. Review and respond to escalations when a specialist cannot determine the next action; surface recurring payer, workflow, or system issues to leadership and coordinate their resolution. Ensure claim activity, supporting evidence, next actions, and follow-up dates are documented accurately in the applicable AR workflow and HCHB. Partner with billing, payment posting, prior authorization, clinical, and other teams to resolve discrepancies, obtain documentation, and follow paid-but-not-posted claims through resolution. Review proposed write-offs for documented collection efforts and supporting evidence, and route them through the required approval and posting process. Quality and team development Review claim work for accurate denial interpretation, appropriate action, complete documentation, timely follow-up, and correct escalation; use findings to coach specialists and strengthen performance. Support onboarding, payer and system cross-training, and regular knowledge sharing. Identify patterns behind collection challenges and update SOPs or workflows to prevent repeat issues. Share frontline feedback on AR dashboards and automation with relevant teams to improve prioritization, visibility, and specialist workflows. Basic Qualifications Strong experience in home health revenue cycle operations. Familiarity with Homecare Homebase (HCHB). Experience managing RCM specialists, including tracking attendance and performance KPIs. Experience monitoring workflows throughout the day and identifying risks to daily productivity targets. Experience identifying collection challenges and implementing processes to resolve. Working knowledge of AR follow-up, denial investigation, appeals or reprocessing, and payer-specific filing requirements. Experience reviewing claim documentation and quality, escalating unresolved issues, and coordinating with billing or posting teams. Ability to respond promptly to team questions while managing multiple priorities. Ability to identify workflow or process gaps and help the team address them. Preferred Qualifications Experience managing distributed or offshore revenue cycle teams. Familiarity with commercial fee-for-service and Medicare or Medicare Advantage home health claims, including episodic/PDGM workflows. Experience with AR dashboards, clearinghouses, and payer portals such as Waystar and Availity. Experience using denial trends, quality reviews, or operational data to improve collections workflows and team training. What We Offer Competitive salary Comprehensive health insurance, dental, and commuter benefits 401(k) retirement plan with employer contribution Opportunity for growth in a fast-growing company Collaborative team valuing innovation and problem-solving Please mention the word **MAJESTY** and tag RNTIuMTczLjE4MS4xMzI= when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RNTIuMTczLjE4MS4xMzI=). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.

Ensure claim activity, supporting evidence, next actions, and follow-up dates are documented accurately in the applicable AR workflow and HCHB. Partner with billing, payment posting, prior authorization, clinical, and other teams to resolve discrepancies, obtain documentation, and follow paid-but-not-posted claims through resolution. Review proposed write-offs for documented collection efforts and supporting evidence, and route them through the required approval and posting process. Quality and team development Review claim work for accurate denial interpretation, appropriate action, complete documentation, timely follow-up, and correct escalation; use findings to coach specialists and strengthen performance. Support onboarding, payer and system cross-training, and regular knowledge sharing. Identify patterns behind collection challenges and update SOPs or workflows to prevent repeat issues. Share frontline feedback on AR dashboards and automation with relevant teams to improve prioritization, visibility, and specialist workflows. Basic Qualifications Strong experience in home health revenue cycle operations. Familiarity with Homecare Homebase (HCHB). Experience managing RCM specialists, including tracking attendance and performance KPIs. Experience monitoring workflows throughout the day and identifying risks to daily productivity targets. Experience identifying collection challenges and implementing processes to resolve. Working knowledge of AR follow-up, denial investigation, appeals or reprocessing, and payer-specific filing requirements. Experience reviewing claim documentation and quality, escalating unresolved issues, and coordinating with billing or posting teams. Ability to respond promptly to team questions while managing multiple priorities. Ability to identify workflow or process gaps and help the team address them. Preferred Qualifications Experience managing distributed or offshore revenue cycle teams. Familiarity with commercial fee-for-service and Medicare or Medicare Advantage home health claims, including episodic/PDGM workflows. Experience with AR dashboards, clearinghouses, and payer portals such as Waystar and Availity. Experience using denial trends, quality reviews, or operational data to improve collections workflows and team training. What We Offer Competitive salary Comprehensive health insurance, dental, and commuter benefits 401(k) retirement plan with employer contribution Opportunity for growth in a fast-growing company Collaborative team valuing innovation and problem-solving Please mention the word **MAJESTY** and tag RNTIuMTczLjE4MS4xMzI= when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RNTIuMTczLjE4MS4xMzI=). Built by the team behind DEUNAâthe fastest-growing Commerce OS in Latin AmericaâATHIA combines payment intelligence, checkout optimization, and data orchestration in one powerful solution. With deep integrations across 300+ PSPs and alternative payment methods, and over 20% of Mexicoâs digital economy running through our platform, we simplify global payments through a single integration and centralized reconciliation. We are a rapidly growing startup expanding into the U.S. to meet the urgent needs of large retailers, marketplaces, airlines, and QSRs. Join us to shape the future of payments! ð Visit https://www.deuna.com/ to learn more about us! You will help monitor merchant technical health, support incident management, answer ongoing technical questions, and guide merchants through future technical evolutions. For DEUNAâs premium and key accounts, the TAM plays a critical role in making sure merchants feel technically protected, proactively monitored, and confident operating on our platform. Your mission is to help ensure every merchant is operationally stable, technically satisfied, and continuously improving on DEUNA. Responsibilities Proactively monitor merchant technical health Monitor merchant performance, transaction behavior, errors, declines, latency, and anomalies. Identify potential risks before they become merchant-impacting issues. Raise internal flags when technical or operational risks are detected. Help maintain account-specific dashboards, alerts, and health views for key merchants. Support technical incident management Triage merchant-reported and internally detected issues. Escalate issues to the appropriate on-call, Engineering, Product, or Operations teams. Track resolution and ensure timely internal and external follow-up. Help ensure communication with merchants is clear, factual, and timely. Support post-incident follow-up, including impact explanation, corrective actions, and prevention measures when required. Drive merchant technical improvements Identify opportunities to improve merchant performance, stability, acceptance rate, routing behavior, fraud flows, provider configuration, or processing cost. Partner with Account Management to support merchant expansion and long-term account growth. Help merchants adopt new payment methods, providers, features, or technical capabilities after launch. Build merchant health visibility Build and deliver simple Merchant Health Reports periodically to Account Management and/or merchants. Help prioritize and advocate for merchantsâ technical needs internally. Requirements 3+ years in Technical Account Management, Merchant Support, Solutions Engineering, Technical Customer Success, or similar roles. Strong technical understanding of online payment ecosystems, including APIs, SDKs, transaction flows, processors, acquirers, fraud tools, chargebacks, refunds, captures, and 3DS. Experience with incident management, post-launch technical operations, technical troubleshooting, and client-facing support. Ability to analyze logs, dashboards, error patterns, transaction behavior, and operational metrics. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to simplify technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders. Strong organization, ownership, urgency, and follow-up discipline. Fluent in Spanish and English. Experience working with LatAm merchants is a must. Startup environment experience is a plus. What Success Looks Like A successful TAM helps premium merchants feel that DEUNA is actively watching over their payment operation, not simply reacting when something breaks. The TAM should help ensure that: Merchant issues are detected and escalated quickly. Critical incidents are followed through with urgency and ownership. Merchants receive clear and timely technical communication. Account Management has strong technical support to retain and expand key accounts. Merchants continuously improve their technical performance and payment outcomes on DEUNA. \n \n What will you find when you join DEUNA? - A multicultural team distributed throughout LATAM - Dynamism, agility and constant innovation - Being part of a high-impact solution for an entire region - The best tools and technology to operate - Being part of the startup culture. - We are in full expansion! items.summary: Customer Success Manager Remote | North America About Hubstaff Hubstaff helps organizations around the world optimize productivity and workforce operations. Trusted by 20,000+ businesses, our platform powers time tracking, team management, project insights, and payroll automation. We’ve been a remote-first company for over a decade — and we’re on a mission to help distributed teams…
items.description: Customer Success Manager Remote | North America About Hubstaff Hubstaff helps organizations around the world optimize productivity and workforce operations. Trusted by 20,000+ businesses, our platform powers time tracking, team management, project insights, and payroll automation. We’ve been a remote-first company for over a decade — and we’re on a mission to help distributed teams work smarter, not harder. The Role We’re hiring a Customer Success Manager (NAMER) to own the customer journey end to end — ensuring rapid activation, long-term adoption, retention, and expansion of Hubstaff across a portfolio of ~150 mid-market and Enterprise customers across North and South America. Your focus will span Onboarding, Adoption, Retention, Expansion, Renewal, Billing, and Escalations , ensuring every customer achieves measurable outcomes and lasting value from Hubstaff. This is a strategic and hands-on role: you’ll act as the trusted advisor to your customers, collaborating cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Marketing, and Support to deliver world-class experiences and sustainable growth. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on building strong relationships, solving complex problems with empathy, and driving impact through data and insight. You’ll report to Customer Success Team Lead, working with peers across the Americas and Europe in a highly collaborative, remote-first environment. What You’ll Do Own client activation and onboarding — become a Hubstaff subject matter expert and guide new customers from deal close through successful adoption. Lead live onboarding sessions, follow-ups, and check-ins to ensure customers realize time-to-value quickly. Manage ongoing customer relationships — conduct value-driven business reviews, track progress toward customer goals, and proactively drive retention and growth across your book of business. Be directly responsible for Gross and Net Revenue Retention (GRR & NRR) across your book of business. Manage renewals and the associated process, expansion opportunities, and at-risk accounts, ensuring Hubstaff’s customers are retained and setup to grow with us. Build and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with key decision-makers and daily users, becoming their advocate and advisor. Deliver key account insights : report on customer health, renewal risk, and expansion opportunities to the wider Hubstaff leadership team. Develop scalable processes and playbooks that streamline onboarding and lifecycle management, contributing to a continuously improving Customer Success practice. Use data to drive action : monitor product adoption metrics, health and associated alerts, feature usage, and engagement data to identify risk or opportunity, and implement targeted success plans. Educate and enable customers through webinars, product walkthroughs, and resources that increase confidence, adoption, and satisfaction. Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Support, and Engineering teams to resolve issues quickly, advocate for customer feedback, and influence roadmap decisions. Continuously experiment and iterate : test engagement approaches, refine playbooks, and share learnings to enhance customer outcomes and internal efficiency. What You’ll Bring 4+ years of experience in Customer Success within a PLG SaaS company. Proven experience managing 100+ accounts , balancing proactive engagement with operational efficiency. Strong ownership mentality — you’re accountable for your customers’ results and take initiative to solve problems before they escalate. Exceptional relationship and communication skills , able to engage both executive and operational stakeholders with credibility and empathy. Comfortable working with data, dashboards, and customer metrics to inform decisions and drive performance. Experience influencing renewal, retention, and expansion outcomes , ideally in a PLG or subscription-based SaaS model. Familiarity with tools such as Vitally, HubSpot, Slack, and Stripe is a plus. Self-motivated, comfortable working autonomously in a distributed team , and energized by a high-growth, evolving environment. Compensation & Bonus The base salary for this role is $80,000–$100,000 annually , plus the opportunity to earn additional compensation through a quarterly performance bonus. Our bonus plan rewards your impact on customer success, with incentives tied to customer retention and expansion goals. Why You’ll Love Working at Hubstaff Fully remote role with flexible working hours Meaningful work — you’ll help thousands of teams operate more effectively and sustainably every day Supportive culture built on trust, autonomy, and balance Private health insurance, paid time off, and local benefits (for employees) Annual stipends for home office, wellness, or professional development Clear career progression pathways, mentorship opportunities, and skill development programs Global company retreats in unique destinations, co nnecting our remote team in person Inclusion at Hubstaff We welcome and celebrate diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. Everyone deserves to feel valued and supported — and we’re committed to creating an inclusive environment for all.

items.title: Market Access Manager
items.summary: At Veracyte, we offer exciting career opportunities for those interested in joining a pioneering team that is committed to transforming cancer care for patients across the globe. Working at Veracyte enables our employees to not only make a meaningful impact on the lives of patients, but to also learn and grow within a purpose driven…
items.description: At Veracyte , we offer exciting career opportunities for those interested in joining a pioneering team that is committed to transforming cancer care for patients across the globe. Working at Veracyte enables our employees to not only make a meaningful impact on the lives of patients, but to also learn and grow within a purpose driven environment. This is what we call the Veracyte way – it’s about how we work together, guided by our values, to give clinicians the insights they need to help patients make life-changing decisions. Our Values: We Seek A Better Way : We pursue bold ideas, embrace complexity, and keep pushing forward. We Make It Happen : We act with urgency, deliver with excellence, and always find a way. We Are Stronger Together : We engage with empathy, align around what's best for Veracyte, and celebrate as one team. We Care Deeply : We show up with integrity, kindness, and respect for one another. The Position: The Market Access Manager is responsible for the operational infrastructure that enables successful Market Access execution across Veracyte’s diagnostic testing portfolio, including payer credentialing and enrollment, state Medicaid participation, contract implementation, and the system of record for all Market Access agreements and documentation. Reporting to the Director, Market Access & Payer Relations, this individual will partner closely with Market Access, Reimbursement Operations (RCM), external consultants, Client Services, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Regulatory, and Commercial Operations teams to ensure payer contracting and coverage strategies are translated into accurate operational execution. The ideal candidate combines deep knowledge of healthcare reimbursement operations with a proactive, solutions-oriented mindset and a passion for improving patient access to innovative diagnostic testing. Key responsibilities: Lead all payer credentialing, re-credentialing, enrollment, and network participation activities across commercial payers, Medicare contractors, all state Medicaid programs and their associated managed care plans, laboratory benefit managers, and other reimbursement stakeholders. Own the end-to-end lifecycle, including initial applications, revalidation, roster and demographic updates, and ongoing maintenance requirements. Manage state-specific Medicaid enrollment requirements, including out-of-state laboratory enrollment where permitted, documentation and attestations, application fees, risk-level screening obligations such as fingerprinting and site visits, and subsequent contracting with Medicaid managed care plans once state enrollment is active. Manage federal government documentation, including SAM ID and associated opportunities, Federal Supply Schedule changes, FSS applications, and documents related to SBA plans, within required federal timelines. Coordinate ownership, control, and managing employee disclosures required by payer and government enrollment applications, working with Legal, Human Resources, Compliance, and executive leadership to gather and safeguard sensitive information. Maintain accurate laboratory, facility, and organizational records across payer systems and enrollment platforms, including NPPES and PECOS demographic data, NPI and taxonomy assignments, PTAN alignment, W-9 and remittance addresses, and payer directory listings. Partner with Regulatory and Quality to ensure CLIA certification and state clinical laboratory licenses and permits remain current, and align enrollment activities with state licensure prerequisites. Own the contract lifecycle after execution, including effective and termination dates, renewal and notice windows, amendments, and escalation of approaching deadlines to the contracting leads. Establish and maintain the system of record for market access documentation, including executed agreements and amendments, payer medical policies and coverage determinations, payer correspondence, and supporting evidence and dossier materials. Maintain version control, access permissions, and retention standards across document management, Customer Relationship Management (CRM), and Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) platforms. Collaborate with Reimbursement Operations (RCM) teams to identify and resolve enrollment-related claim issues, reimbursement delays, and payer operational challenges, including those involving payer portals such as Availity. Develop and maintain standard operating procedures, process documentation, and operational controls related to enrollment, payer setup, contract administration, and reimbursement operations. Support related payer audits, credentialing reviews, and compliance requests. Select, implement, and administer enrollment tracking and contract repository systems, and manage credentialing vendors, external consultants, and third-party partners. Develop dashboards, reporting, and key performance indicators that measure operational performance, including enrollment cycle time by payer type, percentage of target Medicaid lives with active enrollment, on-time revalidation rate, denial dollars attributable to enrollment or configuration defects, and contract record completeness. Evaluate current workflows, identify opportunities for operational efficiencies, and execute process improvements through the effective use of automation and artificial intelligence (AI) tools. Manage group inboxes for payer correspondence and contracting communications. Who You Are: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. A minimum of 6 – 7 years of experience in healthcare reimbursement operations, payer credentialing, provider enrollment, managed care operations, revenue cycle, market access operations, or a related function. Demonstrated experience managing payer enrollment across both commercial and government payers, including hands-on multi-state Medicaid enrollment and revalidation. Working knowledge of enrollment systems and requirements relevant to facility and laboratory entities, including NPPES, PECOS, state Medicaid provider portals, and enrollment tracking platforms. Demonstrated ownership of a recurring compliance calendar such as revalidation, recredentialing, licensure renewal, or contract renewal, with a track record of preventing lapses. Experience administering contracts, fee schedules, or reimbursement documentation as a system of record, including version control and access management. Strong project management skills, including experience coordinating cross-functional initiatives involving reimbursement, billing, legal, compliance, finance, and commercial teams while managing multiple priorities, deadlines, and stakeholders. Experience developing and maintaining operational documentation, workflows, and standard operating procedures. Ability to manage sensitive personal and corporate information, including ownership and control disclosures, with a high degree of professionalism, accuracy, and confidentiality. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting molecular diagnostics, genomic testing, laboratory developed tests (LDTs), precision medicine, oncology diagnostics, or other specialty diagnostic products. Experience enrolling an out-of-state laboratory in state Medicaid programs and navigating state-specific restrictions on out-of-state laboratory participation. Experience with Medicaid managed care plan contracting and roster processes as distinct from state fee-for-service enrollment. Experience with credentialing and contracting in VA and DoD facilities. Experience implementing or administering an enrollment tracking platform or contract lifecycle management system. Certified Provider Credentialing Specialist (CPCS) or similar credentialing certification. Familiarity with Medicare coverage, commercial payer operations, laboratory benefit managers, and diagnostic reimbursement pathways. Experience working with healthcare compliance, audit readiness, and credentialing governance processes. #LI-Hybrid The final salary offered to a successful candidate will be dependent on several factors that may include but are not limited to years of experience, skillset, geographic location, industry, education, etc. Base pay is one part of the Total Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and restricted stock units. Pay range $100,000—$135,000 USD What We Can Offer You Veracyte is a growing company that offers significant career opportunities if you are curious, driven, patient-oriented and aspire to help us build a great company. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, and are committed to fostering an inclusive workforce, where diverse backgrounds are represented, engaged, and empowered to drive innovative ideas and decisions. We are thrilled to be recognized as a 2024 Certified™ Great Place to Work® in both the US and Israel - a testament to our dynamic, inclusive, and inspiring workplace where passion meets purpose. About Veracyte Veracyte (Nasdaq: VCYT) is a global diagnostics company whose vision is to transform cancer care for patients all over the world. We empower clinicians with the high-value insights they need to guide and assure patients at pivotal moments in the race to diagnose and treat cancer. Our Veracyte Diagnostics Platform delivers high-performing cancer tests that are fueled by broad genomic and clinical data, deep bioinformatic and AI capabilities, and a powerful evidence-generation engine, which ultimately drives durable reimbursement and guideline inclusion for our tests, along with new insights to support continued innovation and pipeline development. For more information, please visit www.veracyte.com or follow us on LinkedIn or X (Twitter) . Veracyte, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer and will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status or disability status. Veracyte participates in E-Verify in the United States. View our CCPA Disclosure Notice If you receive any suspicious alerts or communications through LinkedIn or other online job sites for any position at Veracyte, please exercise caution and promptly report any concerns to careers@veracyte.com

items.title: Business Development Representative
items.summary: Who we are Help Scout started in 2011 with a simple premise: support software should treat customers like people, not tickets. 3+ billion conversations later, more than 10,000 companies use Help Scout to grow relationships with customers of all types, from clients to patients and beyond. Now we’re in a new chapter: not only building…
items.description: Who we are Help Scout started in 2011 with a simple premise: support software should treat customers like people, not tickets. 3+ billion conversations later, more than 10,000 companies use Help Scout to grow relationships with customers of all types, from clients to patients and beyond. Now we’re in a new chapter: not only building AI that gives teams more space to focus on the customer experience, but also reimagining how we operate in an AI-native world. That means shipping and learning faster, without compromising on craft. Great work here carries a strong opinion and sweats the details, regardless of the tools we use to drive it. We’ve been a fully remote team since day one, with 120+ teammates now all over the world. It’s a culture where you’ll be trusted to take ownership, stay curious, and raise the quality of work around you. It comes with clear expectations and a team that will push you to do some of the best work of your career. If that kind of challenge gives you energy, we’d love to meet you. The opportunity Help Scout is building a sales-led outbound motion to win more mid-market customers. Most of our pipeline comes from inbound today & we are changing that mix. This role is the engine for it. We're hiring our first Business Development Representative to join our sales team. In this role, you’ll open conversations with the companies that fit us best and drive pipeline for our Account Executives. You'll also help shape the outbound playbook: which accounts, which messages, and which channels work. As our first BDR, we’re not looking for someone to run an established playbook… we're looking for someone who is eager to help shape one. Does that sound like you? If so, here’s more about the role: What you’ll do Research and personalize. Use an AI tech stack to find the right prospects, from Support/Success leaders to Operations management and company executives. You'll maximize engagement by tailoring outreach using our messaging frameworks and templates, and will check AI-generated drafts before sending. Work defined target account lists. Prospect into a defined list of ideal-fit mid-market companies based on our ICP criteria & strategic campaigns, and flag accounts that are not the right fit. Execute multi-channel outreach. Manage outreach across several channels, including email, phone, LinkedIn, and video. Test and iterate. Run messaging, personas, and channels tests, track what converts at the highest rates, and recommend changes to drive continuous improvement. Report on results. Maintain updated reports and dashboards that illustrate your success rates across campaigns and performance towards your targets. Regularly review results and thoughtful recommendations for improvement with your manager. Hand off cleanly. Partner closely with Account Executives to brief them on sourced meetings with well documented details about the contacts, accounts and messaging that led to the booking. Use AE feedback to regularly improve your hand-offs. About you You’re relentless and resourceful. When a prospect doesn’t answer, you find another way in: a different channel, a different person, a different angle. You take initiative. You’ve built or tested something in your outbound process without being asked, and you can tell us what happened. You have 1 to 2+ years as an outbound BDR or SDR at a B2B SaaS company, with a track record of meeting pipeline or opportunity targets. You've prospected into companies with 250+ employees and know how to tailor messaging based on industry, job title and additional criteria. You’re a great communicator, both with prospects and internal colleagues. You actively use AI tools in your workflow for research, list building, or writing, and can recommend what works (experience with HubSpot & GTM platforms like Apollo, ZoomInfo, Sales Navigator or similar solutions a plus). You can thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. You're coachable and want to grow into a closing role. Compensation and benefits We use a competency-based approach to pay, and pay is the same no matter where in the U.S. you live. Base salary: $71,000 - $77,000 On-target earnings (OTE): $102,000 - $111,000 Company values Happy to Help Help is in our first name! We show up for each other — not out of obligation, but because we’re invested in the team’s collective success. We share knowledge freely, lead with generosity, and practice empathy with our teammates, customers, and community. Craft over Convention Our success relies on the quality and craft of the work we put into the world. The status quo simply won’t work. So we insist on narrow focus, sweating every detail, and relentless pursuit of customer delight. Progress not Perfection Achieving our true potential — collectively and individually — requires constant progress and forward momentum. By creating a culture of curiosity and openness, we aim to create a safe space for mistakes, the ability to identify them quickly, and use them to get better. Own the Outcome Own the outcome means taking full responsibility for the results of your work, decisions, and contributions. It reflects a mindset of accountability, proactiveness, and follow-through. If you “own the outcome,” you don’t just complete tasks, you ensure your work leads to meaningful results, and take initiative to solve problems rather than passing them along. Read more about how we define, share, and live these values here . Benefits And Perks Competitive salary and an internal, transparent salary formula based on market data Flexible time off – you choose the holidays and vacations that make sense for you 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all new parents, including adoption and foster care A home office stipend to help you get set up and productive A co-working stipend up to $300 a month if you choose to work out of your house A yearly professional development stipend of $1,800 to help you grow in your craft If you’re in the U.S. or Canada, we offer top tier health insurance for you and your dependents. Hiring Guidelines: All roles at Help Scout are fully remote. Some positions have specific location requirements. For roles outside the U.S. and Canada, we work with teammates as independent contractors under country-specific agreements. We do not sponsor visas. Teammates must already be authorized to work from their home country. We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a company that embraces and celebrates diversity and inclusion . We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We have read the studies and understand that diverse teams build better products, bring more perspective to the table, contribute to a company’s financial success, and help foster a more inclusive environment for all employees, but the bottom line is that it's the right thing to do. To provide you with the best experience, we can support you with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our recruitment team during your conversation with them. items.description: Design Headquarters: Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada URL: https://www.alveole.com About us 🐝 Alvéole is on a mission to connect people with nature in cities, one building at a time. As a certified B Corporation since 2018, we believe business can be a force for good. We partner with the world’s leading real estate companies to turn sustainability into an experience that tenants can see, touch, and feel. Through rooftop beehives and educational biodiversity programs, we help our clients meet their environmental goals while engaging communities and strengthening their brands. You can find our work in (and on) thousands of properties across North America and Europe, driven by a belief that business and biodiversity can thrive together. Learn more at alveole.buzz ✨ The Role We're looking for a Product Designer to join our Product team and lead the design of our two digital products: MyHive , our customer engagement platform, and Aura , our biodiversity data and insights platform. Until now, design has been handled by a mix of engineers, product team members, and an external designer. It's worked, but as our products grow, we need someone who can take full ownership of design, make decisions, and help us build better experiences for our users. You'll work closely with our Product Director and Engineering team, getting involved in everything from understanding user needs and improving existing features to designing new ones. We're a small team, so you'll have plenty of autonomy, a direct impact on both products, and the opportunity to shape how we approach design at Alvéole. 📍 Key Responsibilities Own end-to-end UX/UI design across MyHive and Aura, from understanding user needs and mapping flows to wireframes, high-fidelity designs, and implementation. Translate complex product requirements, customer feedback, and business needs into intuitive, user-friendly experiences. Collaborate closely with Product and Engineering to shape solutions, challenge assumptions, and make thoughtful design decisions. Build, maintain, and evolve a consistent design system across both products, improving usability and reducing design inconsistencies. Conduct or contribute to user research, customer interviews, and usability testing to validate ideas and continuously improve the experience. Design responsive experiences across desktop and mobile, balancing usability, accessibility, technical feasibility, and business priorities. Support occasional visual design needs, including customer-facing materials and product-related communications, while keeping product design as your main focus. 🎯 You're the Ideal Fit If You Have Must-Haves Around 3+ years of experience in Product Design, UX/UI Design, or a similar role . Experience designing B2B digital products , ideally SaaS platforms or web applications. Hands-on experience designing for both desktop and mobile , with a strong understanding of responsive design principles. A strong portfolio showcasing your design process, problem-solving skills, and examples of products or features you've helped bring to life. Solid understanding of UX principles, user flows, information architecture, interaction design, and visual design. Ability to work independently, take ownership of design decisions, and collaborate effectively with engineers and product stakeholders. Strong communication skills, curiosity, and openness to feedback. Professional proficiency in English. Nice-to-Haves Experience designing data-heavy products, dashboards, or complex B2B workflows. Experience building or scaling a design system. Experience working in a startup or small product team where you've had significant autonomy. Interest in sustainability, biodiversity, or environmental technology. 🌍 Location & Work Setup Location: Fully remote within Canada Type of contract: Permanent, Full-time (40h/week) Salary: 85,000–110,000 CAD annually 🐝 What's in It for You? 🌱 Join a mission-driven company creating meaningful environmental impact across North America and Europe. 🎨 Take real ownership of product design across two growing digital platforms, with the freedom to influence how our products look, feel, and evolve. 🚀 Work closely with a small, collaborative Product and Engineering team where your ideas and decisions will have a visible impact. 💰 Competitive compensation package. 🏥 Comprehensive health benefits from Day 1. 🌴 Generous and flexible PTO policy. 🏡 Fully remote work within Canada. ⚙️ Our Hiring Process Intro conversation with Talent Acquisition (15 min) Interview with the Hiring Manager Work Sample Presentation + Debrief Offer 🌐 Language Requirements Some roles at Alvéole require proficiency in English and/or French due to collaboration with clients, partners, and team members across North America. Specific language requirements for this position can be found in the qualifications section above. 💛 Inclusion & Accommodations Alvéole is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and welcome candidates of all backgrounds. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, marital status, or military service. If you require an accommodation or adjustment at any stage of the recruitment process, please let your recruiting partner know. 🤖 Use of AI We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our hiring process. These tools assist our Talent Acquisition team; however, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/alveole-product-designer
